text: Eu descobri este lugar na noite passada. Não acredito no que ouvi do dono. Os ótimos funcionários da SuperFarm SuperTruck fazem mais do que apenas o incrível sorvete Superfarm... não, não, não... eles fazem uma variedade enorme de sabores. Alguém sabe onde encontrar? SIM! Vamos detalhar e discutir a nova sorveteria, Melt. ~Os Pontos Positivos~ Bem, o dono é amigo do dono da Superfarm. Acabei de perceber que a Udder Delights também faz parte da rede de sorveterias... então, se você gosta da Udder Delights, vale a pena conhecer este lugar! Adoro a variedade de tudo. Um cara abre uma pequena sorveteria, praticamente ao lado do Lost Leaf, e, por acaso, ele tem sorvetes deliciosos e locais da Superfarm... INACREDITÁVEL!!! Eles têm uma variedade enorme de sabores. Atualmente, eles têm muitos sorvetes e sorvetes com sabor de frutas. Claro, eles têm os sabores tradicionais como chocolate, chocolate com hortelã, etc... mas, vamos, eles têm a Superfarm, que é um sorvete de avelã com chocolate e Nutella, delicioso! Só esse sorvete já é um motivo para vir aqui. Em vez de procurar a caminhonete da Superfarm ou ir para Gilbert, VENHA AQUI! O dono também é muito relaxado, é um pequeno negócio de verdade. Eles também fazem smoothies com os sorvetes frescos da fazenda. Basta vir e experimentar, você vai adorar. ~Os Pontos Negativos~ Realmente, não há muitos pontos negativos. Não está em um prédio muito bonito, está em uma casa reformada, do tipo que você encontra em Roosevelt Row. Não há mesas dentro, então pode ficar quente se você comer ao ar livre. É mais como "leve e vá", se você comer durante o dia. Eu vejo este lugar como um ótimo lugar para a noite, na minha opinião. Está em Roosevelt Row, e isso não é para todos os gostos. Se você gosta de adicionar coberturas e acompanhamentos, eles ainda não oferecem isso, então tenha isso em mente se for essencial. ~Os Segredos~ No geral, este é um lugar sólido, com 4 estrelas. O atendimento maravilhoso e acolhedor (do tipo bom), a variedade de sabores, a frescura dos ingredientes e o fato de que o sorvete é feito localmente, tudo isso contribui para 4 estrelas. É um lugar chique onde os "hipster" vão? Não. É uma loja que serve APENAS ingredientes locais e frescos, feitos na fazenda? SIM. Mesmo as lojas locais mais tradicionais não usam essas fontes tão frescas. A Melt também está aberta das 12 às 12, DURANTE TODO O DIA... Então, você pode aproveitar o sorvete quando quiser! A Melt recebe o selo de aprovação do Jefe! Venha e aproveite!
text_en: I discovered this place last night. I can’t believe what I heard from the owner. The great staff at SuperFarm SuperTruck do more than just offer amazing Superfarm ice cream… no, no, no… they offer a huge variety of flavors. Does anyone know where to find it? YES! Let’s talk about this new ice cream shop, Melt. ~The Positive Points~ Well, the owner is a friend of the owner of Superfarm. I just realized that Udder Delights is also part of the ice cream network… so if you like Udder Delights, it’s worth visiting this place too! I love the variety of everything. A guy opened a small ice cream shop right next to Lost Leaf, and by chance, they have delicious local ice creams and Superfarm flavors… UNRECOGNIBLE!!! They have a huge variety of flavors. Currently, they have many ice creams and fruit-flavored ones. Of course, they also have traditional flavors like chocolate, mint chocolate, etc… but hey, they have Superfarm, which is an almond chocolate and Nutella ice cream—delicious! Just that ice cream alone is enough reason to come here. Instead of looking for the Superfarm truck or going to Gilbert, COME HERE! The owner is also very relaxed; it’s a real small business. They also make smoothies with the fresh ice creams from the farm. Just come and try it—you’ll love it. ~The Negative Points~ Actually, there aren’t many negative points. It’s not in a very nice building; it’s in a renovated house, like those you find in Roosevelt Row. There are no tables inside, so it can get warm if you eat outside. It’s more like “just go ahead” if you eat during the day. In my opinion, this place is great for evenings. It’s in Roosevelt Row, and not everyone likes that. If you like adding toppings and sides, they don’t offer those yet, so keep that in mind if it’s important to you. ~The Secrets~ Overall, this is a solid place, with 4 stars. The great and welcoming service, the variety of flavors, the freshness of ingredients, and the fact that the ice cream is made locally—all contribute to 4 stars. Is it a fancy place for “hipsters”? No. It’s a store that serves only local and fresh ingredients made on the farm? YES. Even the most traditional local stores don’t use such fresh ingredients. Melt is open from 12 noon to 12 noon, ALL DAY… So you can enjoy the ice cream whenever you want! Melt has the approval seal from the boss! Come and enjoy it!
original: I stumbled upon this place last night. I can't believe what I heard from the owner. The outstanding folks from SuperFarm SuperTruck make more than just their amazing Superfarm ice cream...no no no...they make a whole slew of flavors. Guess who has them? YUP! Lets Melt down to the specifics and discuss the new gem ice cream shop, Melt. ~The Good~ Well, the owner is good buddies with the owner of Superfarm. I just realized Udder Delights is also under their tree of ice creameries...so if you like Udder Delights, check this place out! I just love the randomness of it all. A guy opens up a small, nondescript ice cream literally next to Lost Leaf, and he just so happens to have local, amazingly tasty ice cream from Superfarms...GO FIGURE!!! They have a ton of flavors, by the way. Right now they have a ton of sherbets and fruit-flavored ice creams. Of course they have the usual staples like chocolate, mint chocolate, and so on....but come on, they have Superfarm, which if you have yet to have it, is a hazelnut chocolate ice cream, with Nutella added. This ice cream alone is a reason to come here. Instead of tracking down Superfarm's truck or heading to Gilbert for your fix, COME HERE! The owner's also, are very relaxed, its a small business to the T. They also make smoothies out of the farm-fresh ice creams they have. Just come and try this joint, you will love it. ~The Bad~ There really isn't too much. It is not in the nicest building, its in a re-designed home, the kind your used to at Roosevelt row. They do not have seating inside, so it may get hot if eating out in the sun. Its more of a cash n' dash if eating during the day. I see this more of an optimal spot for later in the night, if you ask me. Its in Roosevelt Row, and that is not everyone's cup of tea. If you are the person that like add-ons and toppings, they do not offer that to this point, so keep that in mind if that is a must-have. ~The Down Low~ Overall, this is a solid 4 star spot. The amazingly kind and homely (the good kind) service, assortment of flavors, freshness of ingredients, and the fact that the ice cream is locally made all add up to 4 stars. Is it a swanky parlor where hipsters go to? No. Is it a shop that serves ONLY local and fresh farm-made ingredients? YES. Even most local in-house shoppes fail to use such fresh sources. Melt is also open from 12 to 12...ALL DAY..So you can get your Melt on whenever you want! Melt gets the Jefe Seal of Approval! Come and enjoy!!!

text: A hole in the wall location serving up unique flavors of ice cream and sorbets. I had the Morning Mess and had a Fruity Pebbles macaron on top of that. Awesome sauce.
text_en: A hole in the wall location serving up unique flavors of ice cream and sorbets. I had the Morning Mess and had a Fruity Pebbles macaron on top of that. Awesome sauce.

text: Eu nunca tinha provado um cannoli autêntico antes, e foi delicioso! Meu grupo e eu jantamos na Trattoria e, depois, caminhamos pelas ruas de Little Italy em busca de algo doce. Os biscoitos italianos eram bons, nada muito especial, mas o gelato e os cannolis foram exatamente o que precisávamos! Já estava satisfeito depois do jantar na Trattoria, mas comprei um cannoli, comi duas vezes e levei de volta para o hotel, para depois da nossa ida ao bar à noite – perfeito! Eu recomendo muito este lugar para casais, pois o ambiente noturno era muito agradável. Pena que os adolescentes que trabalhavam lá não fossem um pouco mais simpáticos.
text_en: I had never tried a real cannoli before, and they were delicious! My group and I dined at Trattoria, and then walked through the streets of Little Italy looking for something sweet to eat. The Italian cookies were good, nothing special, but the ice cream and cannoli were exactly what we needed! I was already satisfied after dinner at Trattoria, but I bought some cannoli, ate them twice, and brought them back to the hotel before going to the bar that night – perfect! I highly recommend this place for couples, as the night atmosphere was very pleasant. It’s a shame that the teenagers who worked there weren’t a little more friendly.
original: I've never had an authentic canoli before and it was yummy! My group and I had eaten at Trattoria for dinner and strolled down the streets of little Italy for something sweet. The Italian cookies were good, nothing too special, but the Gelato and the Canoli's were just what the doctor ordered! I was already stuffed from Trattoria, but I got a canoli, took 2 bites and brought it back to my hotel for after our nightly bar trip- perfect! I would highly recommend this place to daters out there as the late-night ambiance was quite beautiful, too bad the high school kids that worked there weren't a bit more friendly.

text: Tudo o que você colocar na boca aqui será delicioso. Eu venho aqui desde que ele abriu, há 5 anos, e sempre é perfeito. A única coisa que me impede de dar 5 estrelas é que agora está muito cheio de pessoas, e o ambiente que o Amélie's tinha não existe mais. Peça o petit gateau, o bolo pequeno de baunilha e morango!
text_en: Everything you put in your mouth here is delicious. I’ve been here since it opened 5 years ago, and it’s always perfect. The only thing that prevents me from giving 5 stars is that it’s now very crowded with people, and the atmosphere that Amélie’s had is no longer there. Order the petit gateau—the small vanilla and strawberry cake!
original: Anything you put in your mouth here will be delicious. I've been coming here since it first opened 5 years ago and it is always perfection. The only thing keeping me from rating it 5 stars is that it is now so overrun with people that the ambiance that Amelie's once had no longer exists. Get the petit gateaux vanilla strawberry mini cake thing!

text: Everything is made fresh and you won't leave disappointed. There's also a dog bowl outside for pups on walks on hot days
text_en: Everything is made fresh and you won't leave disappointed. There's also a dog bowl outside for pups on walks on hot days

text: Sorveteria excelente – definitivamente vale a pena experimentar se você estiver no centro de Madison. O interior é simples, mas eles oferecem uma grande variedade de sabores de sorvete – eu experimentei os sabores de chocolate e manteiga de amendoim em um copo, e foi delicioso enquanto durou :).
text_en: Excellent ice cream shop – definitely worth trying if you’re in downtown Madison. The interior is simple, but they offer a wide variety of ice cream flavors. I tried the chocolate and peanut butter flavors in a cup; it was delicious while it lasted :).
original: Superb ice cream parlor - definitely a must-try if you're in downtown Madison. The interior is ordinary, but they have a wide array of ice cream flavors - I had the chocolate and peanut butter flavors in a dish, and life was very good for the time they lasted :).

text: A gerente pegou nosso pedido e foi educada, mas não muito simpática ou falante. Os outros funcionários que nos entregaram as bebidas foram muito gentis e atenciosos, e conversaram conosco. Pedimos um mocha com um expresso extra e um mocha branco, além de uma garrafa de água. Tudo estava delicioso. Um dos pontos negativos foi quando pedimos a água, a gerente não nos entregou. Tivemos que voltar para pegar quando percebemos que não tínhamos. As bebidas, incluindo a água, estavam excessivamente caras. Uma loja como a Dutch ou a Starbucks teriam sido mais baratas e com o mesmo sabor. Também perguntamos se poderíamos comprar algumas morangos com chocolate e voltar para buscá-los antes do fechamento, para não precisar levá-los para todos os lugares naquele dia. Mas a gerente disse que não faria isso.
text_en: The manager took our order and was polite, but not very friendly or talkative. The other staff members who delivered the drinks were very kind and attentive, and they talked to us. We ordered a mocha with an extra espresso and a white mocha, along with a bottle of water. Everything was delicious. One negative point was when we asked for water; the manager didn’t give it to us. We had to go back to get it when we realized we didn’t have it. The drinks, including the water, were extremely expensive. A store like Dutch or Starbucks would have been cheaper and offer the same taste. We also asked if we could buy some chocolate strawberries and come back for them before closing time, so we wouldn’t have to carry them around all day. But the manager said she wouldn’t do that.
original: The manager took our order here and she was nice but also not super cheery or talkative. The other employees that gave our drinks to us were very nice and welcoming and talkative. We ordered one mocha with one extra expresso shot and a white mocha and a bottle of water. Every thing tasted great. Some of the negative things are when we ordered a water the manager didn't hand it to us we had to come back when we realized we didn't have it. The drinks including the water were super over priced. Dutch or Starbucks would have been cheaper and taste the same. We also asked if we could purchase some chocolate strawberries and come back and get them before closing so we wouldn't have to bring them every where that day. But the manager stated no she wouldn't do it.

text: Vine aquí para tomar algo dulce después de la cena una noche. Había escuchado mucho sobre este lugar, pero nunca tuve la oportunidad de visitarlo. Pedimos una porción de pastel de cumpleaños y un batido de chocolate de cumpleaños. ¡Todo estaba delicioso! Estoy deseando volver pronto y probar el resto del menú.
text_en: I came here one night after dinner to have something sweet to eat. I had heard a lot about this place, but never had the opportunity to visit it. We ordered a slice of birthday cake and a chocolate birthday smoothie. Everything was delicious! I’m looking forward to returning soon and trying the rest of the menu.
original: Came here for dessert after dinner one night. I've heard so much about this place but never had a chance to visit. We got a slice of birthday cake and a chocolate birthday milkshake. Everything was so good! Can't wait to come back soon and check out the rest of the menu.

text: Perdi a conta de quantas vezes já estive aqui. Nunca decepciona. Adoro o donut de pão français. Pena que este não tem cerveja, como os outros.
text_en: I can’t count how many times I’ve been here already. It never disappoints me. I love the French bread donuts. It’s a shame that this one doesn’t have beer, like the others.
original: Lost count how many times we've been here. Never disappoint. French toast donut lifer. Too bad this one doesn't have beer like the other.

text: Fui a Churn por primera vez la semana pasada. Gestionaron todo con las medidas de distanciamiento social de manera excelente, y solo permitían que entrara una persona a la vez. El helado y las galletas caseras eran increíbles, y el servicio era excelente. Definitivamente volveré. La ubicación es fantástica, y está justo al lado de Windsor, junto con los otros restaurantes del proyecto Upward.
text_en: I visited Churn for the first time last week. They handled everything perfectly with social distancing measures, and only allowed one person to enter at a time. The ice cream and homemade cookies were amazing, and the service was excellent. I will definitely come back. The location is fantastic, and it’s right next to Windsor, along with the other restaurants in the Upward project.
original: I went to Churn for the first time last week! They handled everything with social distancing very well and only had one party come in at a time. The homemade icecream and cookies were amazing and the service was great! Will definitely be coming back. The location is awesome and has Windsor right next door along with the other Upward Projects restaurants.

text: Adoro o sorvete e os biscoitos! Sempre peço o de aveia ou o de coco. Quase sempre há uma fila para o estacionamento, mas ela se move rapidamente. Vale a pena esperar.
text_en: I love ice cream and cookies! I always order oatmeal or coconut ice cream. There’s almost always a line for parking, but it moves quickly. It’s worth waiting.
original: Love their ice cream and cookies! I always get either the oatmeal or coconut macaroon. There is almost always a line out to the parking lot but it moves quickly. Worth the wait.

text: In A Nutshell: -If you are looking for nice sweet, cold sweet treat, then Sweet Republic has it covered. -Their sundaes are plentiful, but if you are there on a Friday, Saturday or Sunday, I suggest you order their "Toffee Banofi". -This sundae features 2 scoops of Madagascar vanilla ice cream, fresh bananas, almond toffee brittle & salted butter caramel sauce in a waffle bowl. -It's big enough to share for two. -Take it outside in the warm night air to enjoy. Overall, this is an award winning ice cream shop located in Scottsdale!
text_en: In A Nutshell: -If you are looking for nice sweet, cold sweet treat, then Sweet Republic has it covered. -Their sundaes are plentiful, but if you are there on a Friday, Saturday or Sunday, I suggest you order their "Toffee Banofi". -This sundae features 2 scoops of Madagascar vanilla ice cream, fresh bananas, almond toffee brittle & salted butter caramel sauce in a waffle bowl. -It's big enough to share for two. -Take it outside in the warm night air to enjoy. Overall, this is an award winning ice cream shop located in Scottsdale!

text: Pero, claro, digamos que le damos 3.5 estrellas porque es un concepto divertido. Nuestras amigas disfrutaron de un concierto en Planet Hollywood y caminaron hasta el Cosmo en una misión para encontrar el helado de cereales y la tarta de avena. La fila era increíble, incluso a las 10 de la noche. Pedimos exactamente lo que queríamos, más una galleta de avena para compartir. Para el helado de cereales, nunca he sido un gran fan de las galletas de maíz; pero entiendo el contraste y tal. Creo que la nostalgia vale la pena, y probablemente el precio se basa más en la estética. ¿Quién no ama los tiempos sencillos? En general, todo sabía a una cucharada de azúcar en cada bocado. No podía terminar ningún pedido por mi cuenta; mi tolerancia a la dulzura definitivamente disminuye con la edad.
text_en: But, of course, let’s give it 3.5 stars because it’s a fun concept. Our friends enjoyed a concert at Planet Hollywood and walked all the way to Cosmo in an effort to find the cereal ice cream and oat cake. The line was incredible, even at 10 p.m. We ordered exactly what we wanted, plus a oat cookie to share. As for the cereal ice cream, I’ve never been a big fan of corn cookies; but I understand the contrast. I think nostalgia is worth it, and probably the price is more related to the aesthetics. Who doesn’t love simple times? In general, everything tasted like a spoonful of sugar per bite. I couldn’t finish any order on my own; my tolerance for sweetness definitely decreases with age.
original: But sure, let's just say 3.5 stars because it's a fun concept! Our girl gang enjoyed a concert at Planet Hollywood and walked to the Cosmo on a mission to find the cereal soft serve and crack pie. The line was insane, even at 10pm. We ordered exactly what we wanted plus one compost cookie to share. For the cereal soft serve, I've never been and still am not a huge fan of corn flakes; but I get the contrast and whatnot. I do think nostalgia is worth the hype and the pricing is probably more about aesthetics. Who doesn't love the good 'ol simple times? Overall, everything tasted like a straight up spoonful of sugar in every bite. I couldn't finish any single order by myself, my sweetness tolerance is definitely dwindling with age.

text: ¡La mejor boba en Arizona! ¡Es deliciosa y la tapioca siempre está fresca y masticable! Recomiendo el té de leche con azúcar moreno o el capuchino de matcha con fresas. ¡Ambos son deliciosos!
text_en: The best bubble tea in Arizona! It’s delicious, and the tapioca is always fresh and easy to chew! I recommend milk tea with dark sugar or matcha capuchino with strawberries. Both are absolutely delicious!
original: Best boba in AZ! So yummy and tapioca is always fresh and chewy! I recommend the brown sugar milk tea or the strawberry matcha latte! Both are so delicious!

text: Este lugar es un punto de referencia en la Universidad de Colorado. No es demasiado caro, ofrece una gran variedad de opciones y tiene un ambiente acogedor. Incluso si no eres de la zona, seguro que experimentarás sentimientos nostálgicos al visitarlo. ¡Excelente!
text_en: This place is a reference point at the University of Colorado. It’s not too expensive, offers a wide variety of options, and has a cozy atmosphere. Even if you’re not from the area, you’ll surely feel a sense of nostalgia when visiting it. Excellent!
original: This place is a landmark in CU. Not too expensive, great variety, comforting ambiance. If you're not a local, you will still get those nostalgic feelings when you stop by here. A+

text: Um ótimo sobremesa, mas o atendente foi um pouco mal-educado. Parecia que ele corria o risco de ter problemas se mantivesse a janela aberta para conversar conosco.
text_en: A great dessert, but the staff member was a bit rude. It seemed like he might have problems if the window remained open for us to talk.
original: Great dessert, but the guy working was a little rude. I felt like he was going to get in trouble if he kept the window open to talk to us.

text: La diferencia entre las opciones es impresionante. Campbell's es increíble. He probado las opciones en Lakewood, en el mercado del oeste, y todas me han gustado. Aún quiero probar otros sabores, ya he probado todos, pero definitivamente quiero llevarme una bolsa a casa. Soy un gran amante de la palomita de maíz.
text_en: The differences between the options are impressive. Campbell’s is amazing. I tried the options at Lakewood, in the West Market, and I liked all of them. I still want to try other flavors—I’ve already tried all of them, but I definitely want to bring a bag home with me. I’m a big fan of corn muffin flavors.
original: The dichotomy is to die for!!! Campbell's is amazing! I've been to the Lakewood location, the westside market and I've been happy with them all. I still want to try more flavors, I've sampled them all but I definitely want a bag to go home! I'm an avid popcorn lover.

text: Wide selection of good looking cupcakes. My daughter always gets something chocolate and fun. My wife loves the Vegan Red Velvet. Yumminess in her mouth!! The staff is knowledgeable and very friendly. Love coming here!
text_en: Wide selection of good looking cupcakes. My daughter always gets something chocolate and fun. My wife loves the Vegan Red Velvet. Yumminess in her mouth!! The staff is knowledgeable and very friendly. Love coming here!

text: ¡DELICIOSO! El lugar de helados en Las Vegas. Me recuerda a la heladería local de mi pueblo. La degustación de cuatro sabores es lo mejor. También me encanta el "hurricane". La cola merece la pena.
text_en: Delicious! The ice cream place in Las Vegas. It reminds me of the local ice cream shop in my town. The tasting of four flavors is the best part. I also love the “hurricane” flavor. The tail is worth it.
original: YUM! THE ice cream spot in Vegas. Reminds me of the local ice cream shop in my home town. The four scoop sampler is where it's at. Also love the hurricanes. The line is worth the wait.

text: Fiquei na área trabalhando e consegui chegar logo após a abertura. A variedade de donuts é incrível! Eles criam algumas das combinações mais deliciosas que você possa imaginar, além de oferecer alguns clássicos simples. O lugar está cheio de energia e a equipe demonstra muito orgulho em seus produtos!
text_en: I stayed in the working area and managed to get in right after opening. The variety of donuts is incredible! They create some of the most delicious combinations you can imagine, along with some classic, simple options too. The place is full of energy, and the staff shows great pride in their products!
original: Was posted in the area for work and managed to make it in right after they opened. The selection of donuts is amazing! They dream up some of the most delicious combinations you can imagine as well as keeping a few simple classics on hand. The place is filled with energy and the staff really does show pride in their creations!

text: Pudim Clássico. Embora não seja a opção mais apetitosa, o sabor de limão é a especialidade deles, e tem a melhor textura de qualquer pudim que já experimentei.
text_en: Classic Pudim. Although it isn’t the most appetizing option, the lemon flavor is their specialty, and it has the best texture of any pudim I’ve ever tried.
original: Classic Custard. While not the most tempting sounding choice, Lemon is their signature flavor and it has the best texture of any custard I have ever tried.

text: O sorvete e as bebidas veganas são deliciosos e visualmente muito atraentes! O interior é charmoso e um ótimo lugar para relaxar.
text_en: The ice cream and vegan drinks are delicious, and they look very attractive! The interior is charming, making it an excellent place to relax.
original: Delicious vegan ice cream and drinks are so aesthetically pleasing! The interior is cute and great place to just hangout.

text: Experimentamos o milkshake com leite de cereal e a famosa torta "crack". Ambos estavam deliciosos e satisfazem o desejo por doces no final da noite. Sem dúvida, uma experiência interessante, especialmente se você não encontrar algo parecido em outro lugar, como em Las Vegas.
text_en: We tried the milkshake with cereal milk and the famous “crack” cake. Both were delicious and satisfy the craving for sweets at the end of the night. undoubtedly, it’s an interesting experience, especially if you don’t find anything similar elsewhere, like in Las Vegas.
original: We had the cereal milk boozy shake and the famous crack pie. Both were good enough and hit the late night sweet tooth craving. Certainly a fun try for one of those things you might not have anywhere else but In Vegas.

text: Melt is a great place to go for decent ice cream and unique flavors! They got rid of their six flavor sampler, but you really can't go wrong here. Their horchata flavor was amazing and I haven't had a bad cereal flavor yet. With that said, the comments about there being pieces of ice crystals in the ice cream are accurate. Sure, it doesn't compromise the flavor, but it does show it's not the best made ice cream in town. Also, I don't really get the novelty of the ice cream coming in Chinese take-out boxes, but some people really get a kick out of it. Lastly, street parking can be rough to find some nights (but hey, it is downtown Phoenix so what do you expect). This place is definitely worth checking out because of the unique flavors and convenience, but Melt and Mary Coles are close to downtown too and they might be better!
text_en: Melt is a great place to go for decent ice cream and unique flavors! They got rid of their six flavor sampler, but you really can't go wrong here. Their horchata flavor was amazing and I haven't had a bad cereal flavor yet. With that said, the comments about there being pieces of ice crystals in the ice cream are accurate. Sure, it doesn't compromise the flavor, but it does show it's not the best made ice cream in town. Also, I don't really get the novelty of the ice cream coming in Chinese take-out boxes, but some people really get a kick out of it. Lastly, street parking can be rough to find some nights (but hey, it is downtown Phoenix so what do you expect). This place is definitely worth checking out because of the unique flavors and convenience, but Melt and Mary Coles are close to downtown too and they might be better!

text: Magníficas donas y un ambiente encantador. Servicio excelente y una gran variedad de opciones. ¡Definitivamente vale la pena visitarlo!
text_en: Great hosts and a charming atmosphere. Excellent service with a wide variety of options. Definitely worth visiting!
original: Great donuts and cute atmosphere. Frequently service and such a selection. Go check it out.

text: Mitchell's es el lugar ideal, tanto en invierno como en verano. Esta cadena de helados en Cleveland es realmente especial. Sus elaboraciones caseras están llenas de sabores que recordará durante mucho tiempo, incluso después de que se derritan en su boca. El precio es un poco elevado, pero no es excesivo, considerando que todos los ingredientes son frescos y provienen de proveedores locales. Apoye este lugar y disfrute de un delicioso helado :)
text_en: Mitchell’s is the perfect place, both in winter and summer. This ice cream chain in Cleveland is truly special. Their homemade flavors are full of tastes that you will remember for a long time, even after they melt in your mouth. The price is a bit high, but it’s not excessive, considering that all ingredients are fresh and come from local suppliers. Support this place and enjoy a delicious ice cream :)
original: Mitchell's is the place to be whether it is the winter or summer! This ice cream chain in Cleveland is so special. It's homemade batches are filled with flavors you'll cherish long after they melt in your mouth. The cost is a little high, but not terrible considering all the ingredients are fresh and most local! Support this gem and enjoy some ice cream :)

text: Personalmente, después de cenar en Lola's, no tenía más espacio en mi estómago para postre, pero mi hermana insistió en que visitáramos este lugar. Parecía una fábrica. Pides tu helado en un lado del cristal y en el otro ves a los trabajadores preparando tu helado. No estaba seguro de si me gustaba la atmósfera del lugar, porque sentía que era muy industrial y un poco fría. El helado estaba bueno y las porciones eran generosas. Sin embargo, he probado helados mejores y no sentí que este fuera realmente el ideal. Probamos varios sabores y ninguno destacó particularmente. Prefiero Jeni's, y además, como no soy de Columbus, no puedo decir que sea un producto local. Pero supe que era una mala señal, ¡porque mi hermana, que ama el helado, ni siquiera terminó la suya! En cambio, la dejó en el reposabrazos junto a mi teléfono, esperando a que yo metiera los dedos en el helado. ¡Qué asco!
text_en: Personally, after dinner at Lola’s, I didn’t have any room in my stomach for dessert. But my sister insisted that we go to this place. It looked like a factory. You order your ice cream from one side of the glass, and on the other side, you see the workers preparing your ice cream. I wasn’t sure if I liked the atmosphere there, because it felt very industrial and a bit cold. The ice cream was good, and the portions were generous. However, I’ve tried better ice creams before, and this didn’t really feel like the ideal choice. We tried several flavors, but none stood out particularly. I prefer Jeni’s, and since I’m not from Columbus, I can’t say it’s a local product. But I knew it was a bad sign, because my sister, who loves ice cream, didn’t even finish hers! Instead, she left it on the armrest next to my phone, waiting for me to put my fingers in the ice cream. What disgusting!
original: Personally after having Lola's for dinner I couldn't find more room in my stomach for dessert, but my sister insisted in checking this place out. It looked like a freaking factory. You order your ice cream on one side of the glass and the other side you see workers toiling away making your ice cream. I couldn't decide if I liked the feeling of this place because it felt very industrial and kinda cold. The ice cream was good and the portions were generous. However, I've had better ice cream and I didn't feel like this really hit the spot. We tried a good number of flavors and nothing really stood out. I vote Jeni's and because I'm not really from Columbus you can't say its Columbus pride. But I knew it was a bad sign because my sister, who loves loves loves ice cream, didn't even finish hers! Instead she left it in the cup holder next to my phone, waiting for me to dip my fingers in the slurry. Yuck.

text: Incrível. Histórico. Único. Acessível. Bem administrado. Uma joia em Pittsburgh!
text_en: Incredible. Historical. Unique. Accessible. Well managed. A gem in Pittsburgh!
original: Amazing. Historical. Unique. Affordable. Efficiently run. Pittsburgh gem!

text: A Presti's é uma padaria bem agradável, com diversas opções de refeições, além de produtos de confeitaria (sanduíches, saladas, pizzas, sopas) – eu particularmente gosto do ganache e de outros biscoitos para me manter feliz enquanto estudo. Os pequenos cheesecakes também são deliciosos, e há algumas opções disponíveis. Fica bastante movimentada nas noites de fim de semana, mas geralmente vale a pena esperar. Sinto que poderiam ter mais opções, mas estou bastante satisfeito com as escolhas disponíveis aqui.
text_en: A Presti’s is a very pleasant bakery with various food options, as well as baked goods like sandwiches, salads, pizzas, and soups. I particularly like the ganache and other biscuits that help me stay happy while studying. The small cheesecakes are also delicious, and there are several choices available. It’s quite busy on weekend nights, but usually it’s worth waiting. I feel like they could offer more options, but I’m quite satisfied with what’s available here.
original: Presti's is a pretty good bakery with many meal choices as well as baked goods (sandwiches, salads, pizzas, soup) - I especially like the ganache and other cookies to keep me happy while I study. The small cheesecakes are tasty as well, and there are a few options. It gets busy weekend evenings but is generally well worth the wait. I feel like there could be more options but I am fairly happy with the choices here.

text: Crack pie yesss! Blueberry pie cookie noooo! Well that's all I had but I would go back and get a whole pie!
text_en: Crack pie yesss! Blueberry pie cookie noooo! Well that's all I had but I would go back and get a whole pie!

text: Este lugar é ótimo. Meu lugar favorito em Charlotte. Há uma localização facilmente acessível na Pineville-Mathews Rd., perto de Pineville. É muito fácil de encontrar em um centro comercial agradável. É grande e muito bonito por dentro. Também oferece algumas bebidas alcoólicas. Há muita gente. Cappuccinos excelentes. Os doces são simplesmente incríveis. Este lugar tem uma atmosfera muito boa, ótimos clientes e um lugar incrível para relaxar.
text_en: This place is great. My favorite spot in Charlotte. It’s located in a easily accessible area on Pineville-Mathews Rd., near Pineville. It’s very easy to find in a pleasant shopping center. It’s spacious and beautifully decorated inside. They also offer some alcoholic drinks. There are lots of people. The cappuccinos are excellent. The desserts are simply amazing. This place has a really nice atmosphere, great customers, and it’s an awesome place to relax.
original: This place is great. My favorite place in Charlotte. There is a location easily reachable in Pineville-Mathews Rd. near Pineville. It's really easy to find in a nice shopping center. It's big and really nice inside. Also has some alcoholic drinks. Big crowd. Great cappuccinos. Pastries are completely beyond belief. This place has such a good atmosphere, great clients, and an incredible place to hang out.

text: I have wanted to try Milk for along time. I was so excited to find out there was a location in Vegas. I have heard so many good things about the cereal flavored ice cream. I got the ice cream and a piece of vanilla confetti cake. The cake was awesome! The ice cream not so much! The ice cream was not very sweet and salty. I didn't like it at all! I feel it's very overrated. My biggest complaint is the price $6 for ice cream and $1.25 for some added cereal topping. The cake slice was $14. Now I know we are in Vegas and everything is over priced, but it really wasn't worth it. I ended up being disappointed .
text_en: I have wanted to try Milk for along time. I was so excited to find out there was a location in Vegas. I have heard so many good things about the cereal flavored ice cream. I got the ice cream and a piece of vanilla confetti cake. The cake was awesome! The ice cream not so much! The ice cream was not very sweet and salty. I didn't like it at all! I feel it's very overrated. My biggest complaint is the price $6 for ice cream and $1.25 for some added cereal topping. The cake slice was $14. Now I know we are in Vegas and everything is over priced, but it really wasn't worth it. I ended up being disappointed .

text: O sorvete mais incrível de todos os tempos!!!! Cresci fora de Youngstown, Ohio, onde a empresa foi fundada. Mudar para Las Vegas me fez sentir falta do melhor que havia no leste. Mas, finalmente, a Handel's chegou! O sorvete é exatamente como o de Ohio. Tantas opções de sabores para experimentar, mas nunca consigo escolher meus favoritos! Experimente o sorvete de chocolate com caramelo salgado ou o trufado de caramelo salgado. Talvez você queira optar por um pote inteiro, porque é tão bom. A equipe é muito simpática e o proprietário é incrível! Continuem o ótimo trabalho, Handel's. Até breve!
text_en: The most amazing ice cream of all time!!!! I grew up outside of Youngstown, Ohio, where the company was founded. Moving to Las Vegas made me miss what was best in the East. But finally, Handel’s arrived! The ice cream is just like the one from Ohio. So many flavors to try, but I never can choose my favorites! Try the chocolate with salty caramel or the truffle with salty caramel. Maybe you’d like to get a whole pot, because it’s so good. The staff is very friendly, and the owner is incredible! Keep doing great work, Handel’s. See you soon!
original: The most amazing ice cream EVER!!!! I grew up outside of Youngstown, OH where the company originated from. Moving out to Las Vegas made me miss the best of the best from back east. But long behold, Handel's is finally here! The ice cream is dead on from Ohio. So many flavors to try but I can never get past by favorites! Try the malted chocolate peanut butter or the salted caramel truffle. You may want to pass up the scoop and opt for a quart because it is that good. Staff is super friendly and the owner is totally awesome! Keep up the great work Handel's. I'll see you real soon!

text: Os "sprinkles" (decorações) não causam nenhum problema no meu livro! O atendimento sempre é com um sorriso. Os preços são muito razoáveis, considerando as padarias gourmet. Os sabores de cupcakes sazonais são ótimos e frequentes, o que me faz voltar sempre. A cobertura em tudo é simplesmente divina. Em termos de estrutura, este local oferece todos os diferenciais especiais da Sprinkles, como a máquina de cupcakes e a sorveteria anexa.
text_en: The “sprinkles” (decorations) don’t cause any problems in my book! The service is always friendly and smiling. The prices are very reasonable, considering it’s a gourmet bakery. The seasonal cupcake flavors are great and available frequently, which makes me come back again and again. The frosting is simply divine. In terms of layout, this place offers all the special features of Sprinkles, such as the cupcake machine and the adjacent ice cream shop.
original: Sprinkles can do no harm in my book! Service always comes with a smile. Prices are very reasonable in the scope of gourmet bakeries. The best seasonal cupcake flavors pop up often that keep me coming back. The frosting on everything is to die happy. Structurally this location has all the extra special Sprinkles amenities like cupcake ATM and attached ice cream shoppe.

text: Love this place. Very eclectic. Always good food. The drinks are small, but that's only a problem because they are delicious.everything I have ever had there is great!
text_en: Love this place. Very eclectic. Always good food. The drinks are small, but that's only a problem because they are delicious.everything I have ever had there is great!

text: These donuts are dynamite! If you come near closing (in my case ten minutes before closing) you can get a box of donuts for $10 and this box is like the size of a pizza box. As tempting as that was, I opted for their other end of day special - 2 donuts for $5. The pop tart donut was really like a pop tart...donut. it was so good! That fruity jelly on the inside. Frosting on top. I had no regrets eating this. Well, it was way too big so I only ate a quarter of it. Share. The Apple donut was good even though I ate it the next day! Mind blown. That means they fried it well because usually poorly fried donuts are soggy the next day. I love this place so much I even bought their shirt...Donut kill my vibe!

text: ¡Guau! Me alegro mucho de haber tenido la oportunidad de visitar este lugar mientras cambiábamos de hotel, de Las Vegas antigua a la nueva, durante nuestro viaje. Mi esposo y yo entramos aquí para un desayuno "ligero", sabiendo que teníamos planes de ir a un buffet más tarde, pero subestimé enormemente lo increíblemente deliciosas que serían las opciones de dulces que ofrecía este establecimiento. La variedad de donuts que ofrecían era fantástica; era difícil elegir solo unos pocos (lo cual fue genial, ya que terminamos con algunas opciones adicionales de cortesía). Al provenir del noreste, mi favorito absoluto fue el donut de Maple Bourbon. Era muy grande, esponjoso y tenía la cantidad perfecta de glaseado. A mi esposo le encantó el de Red Velvet, y también disfrutamos de algunos bocados de un donut con glaseado azul y chispas inspiradas en Halloween, así como de otra creación gigante con relleno de chocolate. Yo no soy de los que beben café, pero me dijeron que el café es delicioso. El estacionamiento en la calle facilitó la entrada y salida. Nuestros sobras fueron un delicioso capricho después de un concierto a altas horas de la noche (y nos aseguraron que la calidad sería buena durante hasta 24 horas). El personal fue increíblemente amable y servicial, y dedicaron tiempo a analizar todas nuestras opciones. Un lugar imprescindible en Las Vegas. Se puede decir que es uno de los mejores donuts que he probado en mi vida.
text_en: Wow! I’m very happy to have had the opportunity to visit this place while we changed hotels, from the old Las Vegas to the new one during our trip. My husband and I went in for a “light” breakfast, knowing we had plans to go to a buffet later. But I greatly underestimated how delicious the desserts at this place were. The variety of donuts they offered was fantastic; it was hard to choose just a few (which was great, as we ended up with some extra options as well). Coming from the northeast, my favorite was the Maple Bourbon donut—it was very big, fluffy, and had just the right amount of frosting. My husband loved the Red Velvet one, and we also enjoyed some donuts with blue frosting and Halloween-themed decorations, as well as another giant donut with chocolate filling. I’m not one for drinking coffee, but they said it’s delicious. The parking on the street made it easy to get in and out. Our leftovers turned into a delicious treat after a late-night concert (and they assured us that the quality would stay good for up to 24 hours). The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and they took time to review all our options. An essential place in Las Vegas. It can be said to be one of the best donuts I’ve ever tried in my life.
original: Wow. So glad I had the opportunity to check this place out in between moving hotels from old Vegas to new, mid-trip. My husband and I popped in here for a "light" breakfast knowing we had plans to hit up a buffet later in the day but I severely underestimated how amazing the sweet carb-laden goodness oozing out of this establishment would be. The variety of donuts served up here was fantastic; it was hard to choose just a couple (which was great because we ended up with a few complimentary options as well). Being from the northeast, my absolute favorite was the Maple Bourbon donut. It was so large and fluffy and had the perfect amount of glaze. My husband enjoyed his Red Velvet and we enjoyed some bites of a blue-frosted donut with Halloween-inspired sprinkles as well as another gigantic concoction with chocolate filling. Not a coffee drinker myself but I'm told the coffee is delicious. Street parking out front made for an easy in-and-out. Our leftovers were a nice treat after a late-night concert (as we were assured their quality would be good for up to 24 hours). The staff were incredibly nice and helpful in our decision-making and took their time reviewing all of our options. A must-stop in Las Vegas. Safe to say one of the best donuts I've had in my life.

text: Ao longo dos anos, ouvi muitas coisas boas sobre o Sweet Republic, mas sempre achei que era um lugar de difícil acesso. O trânsito perto da Shea e da Loop 101 é muito intenso durante o dia e após o expediente. No entanto, finalmente decidi ir às 21h, em um sábado, quando as ruas devem estar desertas. Felizmente, estavam, pois precisei fazer uma curva para entrar no centro comercial que abriga o Sweet Republic. Lá fora, há amplo estacionamento e algumas mesas e cadeiras ao ar livre. O interior é bem iluminado, com várias mesas, cadeiras e espaços com assentos em formato de alcova. Há duas vitrines com sorvetes frescos, uma área com deliciosos acompanhamentos e um freezer com potes de sorvete prontos para levar. Ah, e também há uma área de jogos onde você pode pegar um jogo de tabuleiro antigo e brincar com seus amigos. Quando entrei pela primeira vez, não tinha certeza por onde começar. Embora haja um quadro com os sabores do dia e os itens oferecidos (sundaes, milkshakes, café, etc.), senti que precisava olhar para o sorvete para ter uma ideia melhor do que eu queria comer. Depois de experimentar alguns sabores, meu marido escolheu o de coco e limão em uma tigela de waffle. Eu optei por um sorvete de café com lascas de caramelo, calda de caramelo salgado e um marshmallow caseiro recém-torrado por cima. Estava delicioso! (Eu sou apaixonada por marshmallows e este foi incrível.) Havia tantas opções de sabores e tantos tipos de sundae. Adoraria voltar e experimentar todas as outras opções. Tenho certeza de que estou feliz por ter finalmente experimentado!
text_en: Over the years, I’ve heard many positive things about Sweet Republic, but I always thought it was a difficult place to get to. The traffic near Shea and Loop 101 is very heavy during the day and after work hours. However, I finally decided to go there at 9 p.m., on a Saturday, when the streets should be empty. Thankfully, they were, as I needed to make a turn to enter the shopping center that houses Sweet Republic. Outside, there’s plenty of parking space, along with some tables and chairs in the open area. The interior is well-lit, with various tables, chairs, and seating areas in a cozy style. There are two display windows with fresh ice cream, a section with delicious toppings, and a freezer with ready-made ice cream containers. Oh, and there’s also a game area where you can pick up an old board game and play with friends. When I first entered, I wasn’t sure where to start. Although there’s a list of flavors and items available (sundae, milkshakes, coffee, etc.), I felt I needed to look at the ice cream first to get a better idea of what I wanted to eat. After trying a few flavors, my husband chose coconut and lemon in a waffle bowl. I opted for coffee ice cream with caramel pieces, salty caramel syrup, and a freshly baked marshmallow on top. It was delicious! (I’m obsessed with marshmallows, and this was amazing.) There were so many flavor options and types of sundae. I would love to go back and try all the other options. I’m sure I’m happy that I finally got to try it!
original: Over the years, I have heard many good things about Sweet Republic but always felt it was out of the way. The traffic near Shea and the Loop 101 is killer during the day and after work. However, I finally decided to go at 9pm on a Saturday, when the streets should be dead. Good thing they were, because I had to pull a U turn to get into the shopping center that houses Sweet Republic. Outside, there is ample parking and a few patio tables/chairs set up. The inside is well lit with many tables, chairs, and half-booth seating. There are two display cases with freshly made ice cream, an area with delicious toppings, and an ice cream freezer filled with to-go pints. Oh, and there's a game area where you can pull out an old board game and play with your companions. When I first entered, I wasn't sure where to start. While there is a board displaying the flavors of the day and the items they offered (sundaes, shakes, coffee, etc) I felt I needed to look at the ice cream to get a better sense of what I wanted to eat. After a few samples, my husband decided on the coconut and lemon in a waffle bowl. I went with a scoop of coffee with toffee brittle, salted caramel sauce, and a freshly toasted hand-made marshmallow on top. It was delicious! (I'm a sucker for toasted marshmallows and this one was amazing.) There were so many flavors to choose from and so many sundae options as well. I'd love to come back and try all their other offerings. I'm definitely glad I finally gave it a try!

text: Sorvete caseiro delicioso. O sabor de mel e nozes pecan, servido em um cone de waffle, é o meu favorito absoluto. Todas essas avaliações são verdadeiras!
text_en: Delicious homemade ice cream. The flavor of honey and pecan nuts, served in a waffle cone, is my absolute favorite. All these reviews are true!
original: Great home-made ice cream. Honey pecan in a waffle cone is my absolute favorite. All of these reviews ring true!

text: Incrível! Fui depois de conhecer alguns dos bares de cerveja locais, aproveitando uma noite em Cleveland. Este lugar superou todas as minhas expectativas sobre uma sorveteria. Experimentei os "smores" e minha esposa pegou o caramelo salgado, e ambos estavam deliciosos, embora o caramelo seja uma opção muito melhor. O ambiente também é bem legal, já que está em um antigo teatro, mantendo a fachada original. Uma vez dentro, você pode ver os tanques e a cozinha, onde fazem o sorvete, o que também é muito interessante.
text_en: Incredible! I visited this place after checking out some local beer bars during a night in Cleveland. This ice cream shop exceeded all my expectations. I tried the smores, and my wife chose the salty caramel; both were delicious, although the caramel is a much better option. The atmosphere is also great, as it’s located in an old theater, preserving its original facade. Once inside, you can see the tanks and the kitchen where the ice cream is made—which is very interesting too.
original: Amazing! Stopped in after checking out a few of the local brew pubs while enjoying an evening in Cleveland. This place surpassed all expectations that I had of an Ice Cream shop. I tried the Smores and my wife got the salted caramel they were both amazing though the caramel is a much better option. The aesthetic here is pretty cool as well being in an old theatre, keeping the marquee. Once inside you can see the vats and kitchen where they make the ice cream which is pretty awesome as well.

text: Eu encomendei um bolo para o 50º aniversário do meu marido, duas semanas antes de nossa viagem para Las Vegas. Quando fui buscar o bolo no dia da nossa chegada, eles não tinham nenhum registro da minha encomenda. Eles não tinham bolos disponíveis, mas poderiam fazer um para a retirada no dia seguinte, mas não seria um bolo personalizado, pois precisavam de um pedido com antecedência de dois dias. Já havia feito o pedido há duas semanas!!!! No dia seguinte, peguei o bolo genérico e tive que assinar dois documentos que, basicamente, indicam que, independentemente do problema, não posso obter um reembolso. Agora entendo por que eles pedem que assinem esses documentos, pois o bolo foi HORRÍVEL. Eu esperava receber um bolo maravilhoso, como os do "Buddy the Cake Boss", e tenho encontrado bolos melhores no Costco. Que decepção e desperdício de tempo e dinheiro. Eu deveria ter encomendado no hotel Venetian.
text_en: I ordered a cake for my husband’s 50th birthday two weeks before our trip to Las Vegas. When I went to pick up the cake on the day we arrived, they had no record of my order. They didn’t have any cakes available, but they could make one for pickup the next day—but it wouldn’t be a custom cake, as they needed an order two days in advance. I had already placed the order two weeks ago!!!! The next day, I got a generic cake, and I had to sign two documents that basically state that, regardless of the issue, I won’t be able to get a refund. Now I understand why they ask me to sign those documents—the cake was awful. I expected to receive a wonderful cake, like those from “Buddy the Cake Boss,” and I find better cakes at Costco. What a disappointment—and a waste of time and money. I should have ordered it at the Venetian hotel.
original: I ordered a cake for my husbands 50th birthday 2 weeks before we flew out to Vegas and when I went to pick up the cake on the day we arrived they had no record of that order. They had no cakes available but could make me one for the next day pick up but it could not be a custom cake because they had to have 2 days pre-order. I already gave them 2 weeks!!!! The next day I picked up the very generic cake and had to sign in 2 places that basically no matter what the issue is I cannot get a refund. Now I know why they make you sign this because the cake was HORRIBLE. I thought I would be getting my husband this wonderful cake by the Buddy the Cake Boss and I have had better cakes at Costco. What a disappointment and waste of time and money. I should have ordered it from the Venetian hotel.

text: Uau. Eu quero dizer, UAU! Ao entrar e ver os biscoitos italianos espalhados sobre uma das vitrines, me transportou de volta para Nova York/Nova Jersey. Do bolo de migalhas aos brownies, passando pelos biscoitos e muffins, o cheiro era delicioso. A variedade de macarons e outros produtos também elevou este lugar acima da média. O preço também não era muito alto. Era evidente que eles tinham paixão pelo que faziam. E este lugar faz algo que a maioria das padarias não faz: permanece aberta após as 18h. Depois do jantar, sempre procuramos uma boa padaria, mas a maioria está fechada e assistindo a "Jeopardy" antes mesmo de termos a chance de procurá-las e verificar se estão abertas. Mal posso esperar para voltar e experimentar tudo!
text_en: Wow. I mean, UAU! When I entered and saw the Italian cookies scattered on one of the displays, it took me back to New York/New Jersey. From cookie crumbs to brownies, and from cookies and muffins, the smell was delicious. The variety of macarons and other products also made this place stand out from the average. The prices weren’t too high either. It was clear that they had passion for what they do. And this place does something that most bakeries don’t: it stays open after 6 p.m. After dinner, we always try to find a good bakery, but most are closed, and we end up watching “Jeopardy” before we even have a chance to look for them and check if they’re open. I can’t wait to come back and try everything!
original: Wow. I mean WOW. walking in and seeing Italian cookies spread out across the top of one of the displays took me back to ny/nj. From the crumb cake to the brownies, to the cookies and muffins, it smelled so good in there. The variety of macaroons and other assorted goods made this place well above average . The price wasn't too bad either. You could tell they really had a passion for what they were doing. And this place does something that most bakeries don't, stay open past 6pm. After dinner we are always looking for a good bakery to go to, and most are closed down and home watching jeopardy before you even get a chance to yelp them and see if they are open. I can't wait to come back here and try one of everything!!

text: I was not impressed with the Donut Bar. The French toast donut and latte I got were pretty good, but everything else I tried was flavourless. Like a lot of other reviews mentioned, the sugar topping on the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was way too thick, the red velvet donut was very dry and didn't taste like anything, and the Nutella donut was less dry but still had almost no flavour.
text_en: I was not impressed with the Donut Bar. The French toast donut and latte I got were pretty good, but everything else I tried was flavourless. Like a lot of other reviews mentioned, the sugar topping on the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was way too thick, the red velvet donut was very dry and didn't taste like anything, and the Nutella donut was less dry but still had almost no flavour.

text: The line is sooooooo slow!! Don't come here, service is terrible! 15 mins on line and only let 3 more people inside. They make everyone wait outside while the inside is empty.
text_en: The line is sooooooo slow!! Don't come here, service is terrible! 15 mins on line and only let 3 more people inside. They make everyone wait outside while the inside is empty.

text: Sim, moradores de Arizona, eu vou dizer isso. Este lugar é MUITO melhor que o Sugar Bowl. Eu sei, parece um sacrilégio, mas é VERDADE. Ótimo atendimento, sorvetes incríveis! Dá para perceber que são feitos na hora! Mal posso esperar para voltar e levar a família!
text_en: Yes, residents of Arizona, I have to say this. This place is much better than the Sugar Bowl. I know it sounds like a sacrilege, but it’s true. Excellent service, amazing ice cream! You can tell they make everything right away! I can’t wait to come back and bring my family along!
original: Yes, Arizonans, I'm going to say this. This place is FAR better than the Sugar Bowl. I know, it sounds like blasphemy, but it is TRUE. Wonderful service, incredible ice cream! You can tell it is freshly made! I cannot wait to go back and take family!

text: Lots of flavors to choose from. I liked the chai tea and chocolate marshmallow I tried. Didn't care for the icing which was hard as a rock.
text_en: Lots of flavors to choose from. I liked the chai tea and chocolate marshmallow I tried. Didn't care for the icing which was hard as a rock.

text: ¡Este lugar es maravilloso!! Siempre tienen sabores de helado increíbles y nuevos cada vez que vengo. Incluso tienen opciones veganas sin lácteos. Mi sabor favorito de temporada hasta ahora fue "pastel de cumpleaños", pero ya no lo ofrecen, al menos por ahora. Sin embargo, nunca me he decepcionado con lo que he probado. Permiten probar antes de pedir, lo cual es perfecto para los comensales exigentes. Y todo el personal es muy amable y atento. En general, una experiencia excelente en cada visita.
text_en: This place is amazing!! They always have incredible and new ice cream flavors every time I visit. They even have vegan options without dairy. My favorite flavor this season was “Birthday Cake”, but they no longer serve it, at least for now. However, I’ve never been disappointed by what I’ve tried. They allow you to try the desserts before ordering, which is perfect for demanding customers. And all the staff are very friendly and attentive. Overall, an excellent experience every time I visit.
original: This place is wonderful!! They always have amazing new ice cream flavors every time I come in. They even have some dairy free vegan options. My favorite seasonal flavor so far was birthday cake but they aren't offering it anymore, at least for now. I've never been disappointed in what I've gotten though! They allow you to sample before you order so that's perfect for picky eaters. And everyone that works there is so nice and friendly!! Overall, excellent experience every single time.

text: Adoro este café, que oferece bebidas deliciosas, sorvete e doces, uma decoração charmosa e funcionários acolhedores. Adoro o sorvete de matcha e o frappé de matcha com creme de queijo! Os doces também são realmente deliciosos. Já experimentei o tiramisu de matcha, os "creme puffs" de matcha, o pão de matcha, as madeleines, etc. Adoro todos eles, pois são muito únicos e não são excessivamente doces.
text_en: I love this café—it offers delicious drinks, ice cream, and sweets, with a charming decor and friendly staff. I really enjoy the matcha ice cream and the matcha frappé with cheese cream! The sweets are also absolutely delicious. I’ve tried the matcha tiramisu, the matcha “creme puffs”, matcha bread, madeleines, etc. I love them all because they’re very unique and not overly sweet.
original: I love this cafe with delicious drinks, ice cream and pastry, cute decors and welcoming staff members. I love their matcha ice cream and matcha frappe with cheese cream! The baked goodies are really yummy too. I have tried their matcha tiramisu, matcha creme puffs, matcha creme bun, madeleines, etc. I love all of them as they are very unique and not too sweet.

text: I used to get a dozen cupcakes from Sprinkles from a friend from L.A. who never seems to remember which flavors he gets me. The cupcakes pretty much all look the same which my friend describes as "cupcakes with nipples". They have regular-sized cupcakes as well as mini cupcakes. They have regular cupcakes, sugar-free cupcakes, and vegan/gluten-free cupcakes. There's a separate door/line for cupcakes, and ice cream shop. You can go to The Linq and get your cupcakes or order online. They deliver for a fee. You can sign up for their rewards program. My last bakery box include: 1 banana, 4 banana dark chocolate, 1 black & white, 1 black velvet, 1 chai latte, 1 chocolate marshmallow, 1 cinnamon sugar, 1 lemon coconut, 2 salty caramel, 1 sprinkle, 1 strawberry, 2 sugar free red velvet, 1 vanilla milk chocolate. But my absolute favorite is banana dark chocolate. It's like banana bread in cupcake form with delicious dark chocolate on top. Sooooo good! However, it's one of the flavors that's not available daily. Meaning, you have to check the schedule and see what days certain flavors are available. You can purchase cupcake mixes, cupcake stands, shirts and other merch. I could use some banana dark chocolate cupcake right about now...

text: Esperamos en la fila durante casi 30 minutos. Hay una ventana para ver a los panaderos en la parte de atrás. ¡Esa cocina estaba asquerosamente sucia! Se elige lo que se quiere en la barra. Nada tiene descripciones ni precios. Al final, compramos un mini pastel de queso de $10, un cupcake de pastel de zanahoria de $7 y otros artículos con precios ridículos. El pastel de zanahoria estaba seco y sin sabor. El pastel de queso estaba bien, pero no a ese precio. La gamba estaba dura y crujiente. No volvería a este lugar. Solo es popular debido al programa de televisión, pero sus productos horneados no valen la pena.
text_en: We waited in line for almost 30 minutes. There’s a window at the back where you can see the bakers. That kitchen was disgustingly dirty! You choose what you want from the counter. There are no descriptions or prices on anything. In the end, we bought a $10 mini cheese cake, a $7 carrot cake cupcake, and other items at ridiculously high prices. The carrot cake was dry and tasteless. The cheese cake was okay, but not at that price. The clam was hard and crunchy. I wouldn’t go there again. It’s just popular because of the TV show, but its baked goods aren’t worth it.
original: We waited in line for almost 30 minutes. There is a window to watch the bakers in the back. That kitchen was filthy! You pick what you want at the counter. Nothing has descriptions or prices on it. We ended up getting a mini $10 cheesecake, a $7 carrot cake cupcake, and other ridiculously priced items. The carrot cake was dry and bland. The cheesecake was ok but not with $10. The lobster tail was hard and crunchy. I would never come back. It's only popular because of the Tv show, but their baked goods are not worth it.

text:
Pros: Si nunca has probado sus cupcakes... ¡son deliciosísimos! Mi favorito clásico es el de "red velvet", pero prácticamente no puedes equivocarte con ninguno de los sabores, incluyendo la calabaza y la fresa. El personal era muy amable y entusiasta con los productos de la panadería. Este es el único lugar que conozco que también ofrece helados justo al lado, lo que lo convierte en el lugar con más variedad que he visto.
Cons: Definitivamente, estos son cupcakes de alta calidad, así que debes esperar pagar alrededor de $4 por uno, lo que los convierte en los productos de panadería más caros (pero ¡vale la pena!).
En general: Si estás en esta nueva calle, ¡te recomiendo encarecidamente que vayas a visitarlos!
text_en:
Pros: If you’ve never tried their cupcakes… they’re absolutely delicious! My favorite classic flavor is “red velvet,” but you can’t go wrong with any of the flavors, including pumpkin and strawberry. The staff was very friendly and enthusiastic about the bakery products. This is the only place I know that also serves ice cream right next to them, which makes it the most diverse place I’ve seen.  
Cons: These are definitely high-quality cupcakes, so you’ll need to expect to pay around $4 per cupcake, making them the most expensive bakery products I’ve encountered. But it’s worth it!  
In general: If you’re in this new street, I highly recommend you visit them!
original: Pros: if you never tried their cupcakes... They are super delicious! My classic favorite is red velvet but you almost not go wrong with any flavor to include pumpkin and strawberry. The staff girl there was super cheery and ecstatic about the bakery goods! This is the only sprinkles I know that also has ice cream right next door making it the biggest sprinkles I've seen. Cons: these are definitely high end cupcakes so expect to pay close to $4 for one making them the priciest bakery goods too (but so worth it!) Overall: if you are on this newly developed street, I would highly recommend stopping by!

text: Delicious ice creams with lots of unique flavors and lots of choices. I've never had a Jeni's ice cream I didn't like!
text_en: Delicious ice creams with lots of unique flavors and lots of choices. I've never had a Jeni's ice cream I didn't like!

text: Melt used to be good before they switched their ice cream vendors completely to Udder Delights. Don't get me wrong they're still good, but I'd rather eat Blue Bell than eat Melt. Karen's Kreamery was better. Sorry!
text_en: Melt used to be good before they switched their ice cream vendors completely to Udder Delights. Don't get me wrong they're still good, but I'd rather eat Blue Bell than eat Melt. Karen's Kreamery was better. Sorry!

text: I really didn't enjoy the doughnut sandwich I got. It looked amazing but the taste didn't match. The service was great, I felt welcomed and taken care of... I took one bite and throw it in the trash. It was pretty much a waste of money for me- I wish that someone nearby wanted my partially eaten food so it didn't go in the trash...

I took one bite and throw it in the trash. It was pretty much a waste of money for me- I wish that someone nearby wanted my partially eaten food so it didn't go in the trash...

text: ¿Qué puedo decir que no se haya dicho ya? ¡Oh, Amelie's...! Me alegra que no viva en Charlotte, porque si pudiera venir aquí las 24 horas del día (literalmente), estaría en bancarrota y con sobrepeso. El mimosa de clavo de naranja sabe a otoño en un vaso, lo cual podría ser peligroso, así que asegúrate de comer mientras bebes: el danés salado de tomate y pesto, y el pan plano de verduras de raíz son excelentes y únicos. Amelie's es el lugar al que quieres ir todos los días de lluvia (y de sol) (y de noche).
text_en: What can I say that hasn’t been said already? Oh, Amelie’s… I’m glad she doesn’t live in Charlotte, because if she could come here 24 hours a day (literally), she would go broke and gain weight. The orange pepper mimosa tastes like autumn in a glass—which could be dangerous. So make sure to eat while you drink: the salty tomato-pesto danés, and the flat vegetable bread are excellent and unique. Amelie’s is the place you want to go every day, whether it’s rainy, sunny, or night.
original: What can I say that hasn't already been said? Oh Amelie's...it's a good thing I don't live in Charlotte because if I could come here 24/7 (literally), I would be broke and overweight The orange clove mimosa tastes like fall in a glass, which might be dangerous, so make sure you eat as you drink-- the tomato and pesto savory danish and the root vegetables flat bread are superb and unique! Amelie's is where you want to spend every rainy (and sunny) day (and night).

text: Huge gourmet donut selections. Plenty of coffee flavors and creams to add if you like. Very nice staff and great management. I had never heard of the plane as I never go downtown. When we got a sweet craving while there Yelp helped us find this gem. I lived it and told my friends and family. It will be fun to try another monster sized sweet treat
text_en: Huge gourmet donut selections. Plenty of coffee flavors and creams to add if you like. Very nice staff and great management. I had never heard of the plane as I never go downtown. text: Un helado extremadamente delicioso, con una gran variedad de sabores interesantes. ¿Alguien quiere helado de mango con habanero? Definitivamente volvería. La ubicación es un poco difícil de encontrar para quienes no conocen el lugar; está justo al lado de la tienda de bicicletas, así que si se pierden, pueden encontrarlo fácilmente.
text_en: An extremely delicious ice cream with a wide variety of interesting flavors. Does anyone want mango ice cream with habanero? I would definitely go back. The location is a bit difficult to find for those who don’t know where it is; it’s right next to the bicycle shop, so if they get lost, they can easily find it.
original: Extremely tasty ice cream, and lots of interesting flavors. Habanero Mango anyone? I'd come back for sure. Location is a bit difficult to find for people not familiar with the place, it is right next to the bicycle shop in case you get lost.

text: ¡Mucho, mucho sobrevalorado! Muy decepcionada. Mis hijas y yo éramos grandes fans de "Cake Boss", así que visitar el lugar de Carlos era imprescindible en nuestro viaje a Las Vegas. La fila no era terrible, pero todo el proceso de pedido y pago fue muy ineficiente. Eliges lo que quieres y luego tienes que esperar a que alguien lo empache. Tuve que probar su famoso cupcake de "red velvet". Nada especial y el glaseado necesitaba mucha más azúcar. Tenía un sabor similar al queso crema. Mi hija probó una gamba... pero estaba demasiado cargada de relleno, lo que la hizo desagradable. Mi otra hija pidió un mini pastel de queso, que estaba demasiado dulce. Normalmente no escribo reseñas negativas, pero esta es la primera vez... Me siento decepcionada porque perdimos tiempo y dinero por productos horneados de tal calidad mediocre.
text_en: It’s overrated! Very disappointing. My daughters and I were huge fans of “Cake Boss”, so visiting Carlos’s place was essential during our trip to Las Vegas. The line wasn’t bad, but the ordering and payment process was very inefficient. You choose what you want, and then you have to wait for someone to pack it for you. I had to try their famous red velvet cupcake. It wasn’t special at all, and the frosting needed much more sugar. It tasted similar to cream cheese. My daughter tried a clam… but it was too filled with filling, making it unpleasant. My other daughter ordered a mini cheese cake, which was too sweet. I usually don’t write negative reviews, but this is the first time… I feel disappointed because we wasted time and money on products of such mediocre quality.
original: Waaaaayyyy overrated! Extremely disappointed. My girls and I were huge Cake boss fans so Carlos was a must visit on our trip to Vegas. Line wasn't too bad but the whole ordering, check out process was so inefficient. You pick out what you want then have to wait for one person to box it up. I had to try his famous red velvet cupcake. Nothing special and the frosting desperately needed more sugar. It tasted like plain cream cheese. My daughter had lobster tail....loaded with way too much filling to make it enjoyable. My other daughter had a mini cheesecake which was overly sweet. I'm not one to write bad reviews....this is a first for me....I'm miffed we wasted time and money for such mediocre baked goods.

text: No military discount here. Minimal seating at this ice cream store. 2 stars, because the employees were unfriendly.
text_en: No military discount here. Minimal seating at this ice cream store. 2 stars, because the employees were unfriendly.

text: Encontré Amelie's después de buscar en Google "postres". Compré dos de sus tartaletas pequeñas. Nos gustó tanto que volvimos al día siguiente. Probé el croissant de chocolate horneado dos veces. El servicio fue excelente y todos los pasteles tenían un sabor fresco.
text_en: I found Amelie after searching “desserts” on Google. I bought two of her small tarts. We loved them so much that we came back the next day. I tried the chocolate croissant twice. The service was excellent, and all the pastries had a fresh flavor.
original: Found Amelie's after googling Desserts. I had two of Their small tarts. We liked it so much we came back the next morning. I had the twice baked chocolate croissant. Service was great and all the pastries tasted fresh.

text: Wow! Mango gelato, coconut macaroon and a toasted marshmallow! Wow! Going to go again! Betty's combo was chocolate gelato, strawberry macaroon and toasted marshmallow. We were very happy to see the reviews and it's closer than (now boring) Dairy Queen. AND supporting a local small biz! BTW the mango was not just mango flavored... you can tell its made from real mangoes. YES!
text_en: Wow! Mango gelato, coconut macaroon and a toasted marshmallow! Wow! Going to go again! Betty's combo was chocolate gelato, strawberry macaroon and toasted marshmallow.
