text: Si solo vas a visitar un lugar en Little Italy, este es el lugar. Es mi lugar favorito para cualquier tipo de pastelería, y sus ofertas de sándwiches diarios son insuperables. Mi favorito absoluto son sus sándwiches para el desayuno, que tienen un precio asequible y son bastante grandes.
text_en: If you’re just visiting a place in Little Italy, this is it. It’s my favorite spot for all kinds of pastries, and their daily sandwich offerings are incredible. My absolute favorite are their breakfast sandwiches—they’re affordable and quite large.
original: If you're only going to visit one place in Little Italy, this is the place. My go to for any kind of pastry; and their daily sandwich specials can't be beat. My absolute favorite is their breakfast sandwiches, which come at an affordable price and are rather large.

text: Depois de experimentar quase todos os lugares de sobremesas na cidade, posso dizer com certeza que o Villani's é o meu favorito. Os seus bolos são úmidos, não muito doces e oferecem uma variedade incrível. Também adoro os seus bialys e fazer sanduíches com ovos e queijo usando-os. O favorito do meu marido é o de pasta de amendoim com ganache de chocolate. Normalmente, tento experimentar algo diferente sempre que vamos. O atendimento é sempre muito amigável e eles ficam abertos mais tarde do que a maioria dos lugares, tornando-o o lugar perfeito para os desejos noturnos.
text_en: After trying almost all the dessert places in the city, I can say with certainty that Villani’s is my favorite. Their cakes are moist, not too sweet, and they offer an incredible variety. I also love their bialy and sandwiches made with eggs and cheese. My husband’s favorite is the peanut paste with chocolate ganache. Usually, I try something different every time we go there. The service is always very friendly, and they open later than most places, making it the perfect place for late-night cravings.
original: After trying almost every dessert place in town I can say hands down Villani's is my favorite. Their cakes are moist, not too sweet and offer an incredible variety. I also love their bialys and making egg and cheese sandwiches out of them. My husbands favorite is the peanut butter with chocolate ganache, I usually try and get something different everytime we go. Their customer service is always very friendly and they areopen later than most places so it's the perfect spot for the late night cravings.

text: Uau. Vamos começar com o atendimento. Encontramos este lugar por acaso, após ler os ótimos comentários no Yelp. O dono nos recebeu como se fossem amigos antigos! Ele passou um tempo conosco, explicando os diversos sabores e ingredientes. Acho que não há escolha errada, todos eram deliciosos. Colocar sorvete em um donut? Eu já estou convencido. Lugar incrível, voltaremos. 10/10, voltaria a comer.
text_en: Wow. Let’s start with the service. We stumbled upon this place after reading the great reviews on Yelp. The owner treated us like old friends! He spent some time with us, explaining all the different flavors and ingredients. I think there’s no wrong choice—everything was delicious. Putting ice cream on a donut? I’m already convinced. An amazing place; we’ll go back. 10/10, I would eat here again.
original: Wow. Let's start with the service.. We just happened upon this place after seeing the positive Yelp reviews. The owner welcomed us like old friends! He spent time with us discussing the many flavors and ingredients. I don't think there is a wrong choice, they were all so delicious. Throw ice cream in a doughnut and I'm sold. Amazing place, we will be back. 10/10 would eat again

text: Me encantó este lugar. Pedí un latte con leche de avena y leche de coco. ¡Ofrecen diferentes porcentajes de azúcar! Además, estoy deseando volver para probar su versión con azúcar moreno.
text_en: I really liked this place. I ordered a latte with oat milk and coconut milk. They offer different sugar percentages! Also, I’m looking forward to returning to try their version with dark sugar.
original: Loved this place. I had the milk rose latte with coconut milk. They do different percentages of sugar! Also can't wait to go back and get their brown sugar test

text: ¡Me encanta Love Mary Coyle! Es un lugar fantástico para los niños y tienen los mejores sabores de helado de la ciudad. ¡Lo recomiendo totalmente!
text_en: I love Love Mary Coyle! It’s a fantastic place for kids, and they have the best ice cream flavors in town. I highly recommend it!
original: Love Mary Coyle! Great place for the kids and best ice cream flavors in town. Highly recommended!

text: Una maravillosa variedad de sabores, muchas opciones veganas, recogida en la puerta bastante sencilla, y los sets de degustación son ENORMES. Es muy divertido elegir los sabores que combinan bien.
text_en: A wonderful variety of flavors, many vegan options, very easy to pick up at the door, and the tasting sets are amazing. It’s fun to choose the flavors that go well together.
original: Wonderful variety of flavors, lots of vegan options, fairly easy curbside pickup, and the tasting trios are ENORMOUS. So fun choosing the flavors that would go well together.

text: Um amigo me presenteou com algumas bolinhas de bolo de aniversário da Milk Bar há alguns anos, e desde então, elas se tornaram meu alimento favorito. Eu esperava conseguir ir à filial em Nova York quando estive lá, mas infelizmente não consegui durante aquela viagem agitada. Convidei meu amigo para vir aqui depois de comermos ao lado no Momofuku, mesmo que ela estivesse "muito satisfeita", ela ainda conseguiu aproveitar uma das bolinhas de bolo de aniversário da embalagem de três unidades. Meu amigo compartilhou sua opinião sobre a torta "crack", que ela recomendou fortemente, pois é o que eles são famosos. Eu comprei uma fatia e estava deliciosa, mas definitivamente prefiro as bolinhas de bolo de aniversário. São os melhores doces que existem (desculpe, mas os bolos bundt não chegam perto – você está em segundo lugar). Também experimentamos o sorvete "crack", pois tivemos sorte e não havia fila. Ele tinha o mesmo sabor da torta "crack", embora eu não saiba se gostaria de comer tanta quantidade de uma vez. Minha escolha preferida, sem dúvida, são as bolinhas de bolo de aniversário, e não vejo isso mudando no futuro, mas certamente estaria aberta a voltar e experimentar mais... ou simplesmente pedir algumas dezenas de bolinhas.
text_en: A few years ago, a friend gave me some birthday cake balls from Milk Bar. Since then, they’ve become my favorite snack. I hoped to visit the New York branch when I went there, but unfortunately, I couldn’t do it during that busy trip. I invited my friend to come over after we ate at Momofuku. Even though she was “very satisfied,” she still managed to enjoy one of the birthday cake balls from the three-unit package. My friend shared her opinion about the “crack” cake—she highly recommended it, as it’s what they’re known for. I bought a slice; it was delicious, but I definitely prefer the birthday cake balls. They’re the best desserts there are (sorry, but the bundt cakes can’t compare—you’re in second place). We also tried the “crack” ice cream; we were lucky and didn’t have to wait in line. It had the same flavor as the “crack” cake, though I don’t know if I would like to eat so much at once. My favorite, without a doubt, are the birthday cake balls. I don’t see this changing in the future, but I would definitely be open to coming back and trying more… or simply ordering a few dozen of them.
original: A friend gifted me some Milk Bar Birthday Cake balls a few years ago and it's basically been my fave food ever since. I was hoping to stop by the NYC outpost when I was there but unfortunately didn't end up making it during that whirlwind trip. I made my friend come here after we ate next door at Momofuku, even though she was, 'too full', it didn't stop her from enjoying one of my birthday cake balls from the three pack. My friend offered up her opinion on the crack pie, which was to definitely get it as it's what they're known for. I got a single slice and it was darn good but I def favor the birthday cake balls, hands down. Those are the best dessert ever (sorry, nothing bundt cakes- you're second tho). We also tried the crack pie soft serve since we got lucky and there was no line. It tasted just like the crack pie, tho I don't know that I'd ever want to eat that much of it in one sitting. My go-to is def the birthday cake balls and I don't see that changing in the foreseeable future but I'd def be open to going back and trying more... or just ordering a few dozen of the balls.

text: ¡EL MEJOR LUGAR PARA COMER HELADO EN OHIO! Sin duda. No pierda el tiempo y vaya a otro lugar. ¡El "Elvis Sunday" es increíble!
text_en: The best place to eat ice cream in Ohio! Definitely. Don’t waste your time—go somewhere else. “Elvis Sunday” is amazing!
original: BEST ICE CREAM PLACE IN OH!! HANDS DOWN!! Don't waste your time going anywhere else. The Elvis Sunday is the bomb!!!

text: Pasé incontables noches estudiando y escribiendo trabajos aquí. Está abierto las 24 horas y ofrece wifi gratuito, aunque a veces puede ser un poco lento y difícil de conectar. También tienen una buena selección de pasteles y postres deliciosos; recomiendo el brownie de caramelo salado. El café también es de buena calidad aquí. Nunca he probado la comida en sí, ya que siempre prefiero los pasteles. Normalmente hay cola, pero suele moverse bastante rápido la mayoría de las noches. El lugar suele estar lleno y puede ser difícil encontrar sitio si vas con un grupo grande, pero si solo son unos pocos, suele haber algo disponible, ya sea dentro o fuera de alguna de las muchas habitaciones. La decoración asegura que siempre haya algo interesante para ver.
text_en: I spent countless nights studying and writing assignments here. It’s open 24 hours a day and offers free Wi-Fi, though it can sometimes be slow and difficult to connect to. They also have a great selection of delicious cakes and desserts; I recommend the salty caramel brownies. The coffee here is also of good quality. I haven’t tried the food itself, as I usually prefer cakes more. There’s usually cola available, but most nights, it moves around quite quickly. The place is often full, and it can be hard to find a spot if you’re with a large group, but if there are just a few people, there’s usually something available, either inside or outside one of the many rooms. The decor ensures that there’s always something interesting to see.
original: I spent countless all nighters here studying and writing papers. Open 24 hours and they have free wifi - which can be a little slow and hard to connect to at times. They have a good selection of delicious pastries and desserts - I recommend the salted caramel brownie. The coffees are decent here, too. Never tried the actual food as I always choose the pastries over them. There's usually always a line, but it will move pretty fast most nights. The place is usually packed and can be hard to find seating if you're going with a large group, but if it's just a few of you there's usually something outside or inside one of the many rooms. The decor makes sure there's always something interesting to look at

text: So Yummy! Love the takeout containers the stickers are so cute and worth going out in the heat to grab some Ice Cream!
text_en: So Yummy! Love the takeout containers the stickers are so cute and worth going out in the heat to grab some Ice Cream!

text: Este lugar era imprescindible para mi hija, que es una gran fan de "Cake Boss". Hubo un poco de espera, pero no fue excesiva y pudimos ver a los pasteleros trabajando. Pedimos un cannoli, un pastel de fresas y un cupcake de bizcocho rojo. ¡El cannoli fue FANTASTICO!! El pastel de fresas tenía MUCHÍSIMA crema batida, pero estaba delicioso. ¿Y el cupcake de bizcocho rojo? Tendrás que creer en la palabra de mi hija, ¡ella no lo compartiría! Quería un tail de langosta, pero era demasiado para este viaje, ¡pero la próxima vez, ¡definitivamente!
text_en: This place was essential for my daughter, who is a huge fan of “Cake Boss”. There was a little wait, but it wasn’t too long, and we were able to see the pastries being made. We ordered a cannoli, a strawberry cake, and a red cake cupcake. The cannoli was FANTASTIC!! The strawberry cake had A LOT of whipped cream, but it was delicious. And the red cake cupcake? You have to believe my daughter—she wouldn’t share it! I wanted lobster tail, but it was too much for this trip, but next time, definitely!
original: This was a must stop for my Cake Boss loving daughter. There was a bit of a wait, but it wasn't too bad and the girls were able to view the bakers at work. We ordered a cannoli, strawberry short cake, and a red velvet cupcake. The cannoli was FANTASTIC!! The strawberry shortcake had A LOT of whipped cream, but it was yummy. And the red velvet cupcake? You'll have to take my daughter's word for it, she wouldn't share! I wanted a lobster tail, but it was too much for this trip, next time FOR SURE!!

text: I don't have one bit of a sweet tooth in my body but my boyfriend and friends do and this is the place we always go to when we want a nice little pick-me-up. Since I don't get ice cream, I usually go for their mangonada, with mango ice cream and fresh mango chunks topped with Mexican salt seasoning. Mouth is just drooling thinking about it. My boyfriend loves the ginormous ice cream donut sandwiches or the milkshakes.

My boyfriend loves the ginormous ice cream donut sandwiches or the milkshakes.

text: Pretty mediocre food for the price. Would expect more than machine made coffee and espresso from a stall that advertises "food fit for a king"
text_en: Pretty mediocre food for the price. Would expect more than machine made coffee and espresso from a stall that advertises "food fit for a king"

text: This place is awesome! The atmosphere. The music. The people. Yes, yes, yes! The Maiko Special is so good. Normally these layered desserts are super (too) sweet but this one is amazing. You can taste the flavors of each item in the cup and nothing is too sweet. The mochi is on point.
text_en: This place is awesome! The atmosphere. The music. The people. Yes, yes, yes! The Maiko Special is so good. Normally these layered desserts are super (too) sweet but this one is amazing. You can taste the flavors of each item in the cup and nothing is too sweet. The mochi is on point.

text: Estaba saliendo a correr y vi que se estaba formando una fila frente a Jeni's. No pude resistirme a la oportunidad de conseguir helado gratis el día de apertura. Me habría bastado con una porción, pero me dejaron elegir cualquier sabor. Al final, me pedí una combinación de brambleberry, almendras crujientes y queso de cabra con cerezas. ¡Estaba delicioso! Gracias, Jeni.
text_en: I was going for a run when I saw a line forming in front of Jeni’s. I couldn’t resist the chance to get ice cream for free on opening day. I could have just had one serving, but they allowed me to choose any flavor. In the end, I ordered a combination of brambleberry, crunchy almonds, goat cheese, and cherry flavors. It was delicious! Thank you, Jeni.
original: Was out for a run and saw a line forming in front of Jeni's. Couldn't pass up free ice cream on opening day. I would have been happy with a scoop, but they let us get anything we wanted! I ended up with a flight of brambleberry, almond brittle, and goat cheese with cherry. Soooo good. Thanks Jeni!

text: Achei este lugar por acaso! Sorvete incrível! Uma porção era enorme em um copo. Experimentei o de amendoim e estava perfeito! Se eu morasse perto daqui, certamente teria ganhado uns 10 quilos!
text_en: I found this place by chance! Amazing ice cream! One serving was huge in a cup. I tried the peanut flavor—it was perfect! If I lived near here, I would definitely gain about 10 pounds!
original: Found this place by accident! Amazing ice cream! One "scoop" was huge in a cup. Got the peanut butter and it was perfecto! If i lived near here i would definitely be 10lbs more!

text: A maioria das pessoas pensa no Amelie's pela padaria, mas essas saladas eram incríveis!!!!!!! Foi apenas US$ 2 a mais para adicionar salmão ou cogumelos Portobello. Eram muito frescas. Eu pedi um molho de vinagrete de champanhe, que tinha um ótimo sabor. Também pudemos sentar ao ar livre e comer. Adoro este lugar para reuniões ou simplesmente para trabalhar por algumas horas.
text_en: Most people think of Amelie’s as a bakery, but those salads were amazing!!!!!!! It was only $2 more to add salmon or Portobello mushrooms. They were very fresh. I ordered a champagne vinegar dressing, which had an excellent taste. We could also sit outside and eat. I love this place for meetings or just to work for a few hours.
original: Most think of Amelie's for the bakery but these salads were amazing!!!!!!! It was only $2 more to add on Salmon or Portobello mushrooms. They were very fresh. I got a champagne vinaigrette dressing which was flavorful. We also got to sit outside and eat. I love this place for meetings or just to come work for a couple hours.

text: Love this place! The owners are friendly and down to earth, and the foods are delicious. The tiramisu and the pimento cheese croissants are not to be missed
text_en: Love this place! The owners are friendly and down to earth, and the foods are delicious. The tiramisu and the pimento cheese croissants are not to be missed

text: Bouchon Bakery, como amamos vocês! Se estiverem com dificuldades para encontrá-los aqui, eles estão localizados sob as escadas rolantes no Venetian. As escadas rolantes às quais me refiro são aquelas que levam à garagem. Ficamos no Palazzo durante o fim de semana e fomos à Bouchon Bakery duas vezes. Não há como errar com os seus produtos! Alguns de nós compraram o croissant com chocolate e amêndoas, o croissant tradicional, os macarons (inclusive o embalado para levar para casa) e o café. Todos ficaram muito satisfeitos com o que compraram. Aqui não há como errar! Este lugar é sempre delicioso :D *Também visitei a unidade em Yountville.
text_en: Bouchon Bakery – we really love you! If you have trouble finding it here, it’s located under the escalators at the Venetian. The escalators I’m referring to lead to the garage. We spent the weekend at the Palazzo and visited Bouchon Bakery twice. There’s no way to go wrong with their products! Some of us bought the chocolate-and-almond croissant, the traditional croissant, the macarons (including those wrapped for home delivery), and coffee. Everyone was very satisfied with what they bought. There’s really no way to go wrong here! This place is always delicious :D *I also visited the unit in Yountville.
original: Bouchon Bakery oh how we love you. If you have trouble finding them here, they are located underneath the Escalators in the Venetian. The escalators I am talking about is the one that leads to the parking structure. We stayed at the Palazzo during the weekend and we went to Bouchon Bakery twice. You can't go wrong with their goodies! Some of us got the Choc/Almon Croissant, Regular Crossiant, Macaroons (even the packaged one to take home) and their coffee. Everyone was very satisfied with what they got. Can't go wrong here! This place is always so yummmmmmmm :D *Also have been to the Yountville location.

text: Certifique-se de pegar um número. Nós compramos uma fatia de pizza, um doce pequeno e uma bebida por menos de 5 dólares. Está localizado no centro de Little Italy. Com certeza voltaria.
text_en: Make sure to get a number. We bought a slice of pizza, a small snack, and a drink for less than $5. It’s located in the center of Little Italy. I would definitely go back.
original: Make sure you grab a number. We got a piece of pizza, a small sweet and a drink for under $5. It's in the heart of little Italy. I'd definitely go back.

text: MACARONS!!! 4 dias em Las Vegas e decidi parar aqui especificamente para provar esses deliciosos macarons que sempre ouvia falar. Não há segredo, os macarons são simplesmente divinos e irresistíveis, mas estes provavelmente foram os melhores que já experimentei. O recheio era um pouco mais cremoso, o que adorei, pois contrastava perfeitamente com a biscoito crocante e doce. Gastei um pouco mais e comprei duas caixas de presente, uma com os mini e outra de tamanho normal. A princípio, os preços podem parecer altos, mas considerando o tamanho do biscoito e a qualidade do sabor, vale muito a pena. Na verdade, só consegui comer a maioria quando cheguei em casa, pois estava comendo tudo o mais na Strip haha. Com receio de que os biscoitos perdessem a crocância, comi os meus macarons em poucos dias. No entanto, fiquei surpreso no quarto dia, os biscoitos ainda estavam quase frescos. Com experiência, nunca consegui que os macarons permanecessem comestíveis por mais de um ou dois dias (se não fossem consumidos!). Da próxima vez, vou experimentar os cupcakes e outras opções, e espero não parar por lá com o estômago cheio. Talvez volte em alguns meses?
text_en: MACARONS!!! I spent 4 days in Las Vegas and decided to stop here specifically to try these delicious macarons that I’ve always heard about. There’s no secret—macarons are simply divine and irresistible. These were probably the best ones I’ve ever tried. The filling was a bit more creamy, which I loved, as it perfectly contrasted with the crispy and sweet cookies. I spent a little more money and bought two gift boxes: one with mini macarons and another with regular-sized ones. At first, the prices might seem high, but considering the size of the cookies and the quality of the flavor, it’s worth it. In fact, I could only eat most of them when I got home, since I was eating everything else on the Strip haha. To avoid the cookies losing their crunch, I ate my macarons within a few days. However, on the fourth day, I was surprised to find that the cookies were still almost fresh. With experience, I can’t keep macarons edible for more than a day or two (unless they’re eaten immediately!). Next time, I’ll try cupcakes and other options, and hope I don’t stop there with a full stomach. Maybe I’ll come back in a few months?
original: MACAROONS!!! 4 days in Vegas and I made it a point to stop here just for those delicious macaroons I keep reading about. There's no secret, macaroons are just simply heavenly and to die for but these were probably the best I've ever had, no lie. The filling was a little more buttery which I loved because it contrasted with the sweet crispy cookie perfectly. I splurged and bought 2 gift boxes, one of the mini's and one regular sized. At first glance, the prices may shock you but for the size of the cookie and quality in taste, it's well worth it. I didn't actually get to eat most of them until I got home since I was stuffing my face with everything else on the strip haha. Scared that the cookies would lose the crispiness, I literally scarfed down my macaroons in a few days. I was surprised though on the fourth day, the cookies were nearly fresh still. From experience, I haven't had any macaroons stay edible for more than one or two days (if they weren't eaten yet!). Next time I will try the cupcakes and such and hopefully not stop by on a full tummy. Be back in a few months maybe??..

text: Sinceramente, não sei o que as pessoas apreciam nesse sorvete. Para mim, esse sorvete simplesmente não tem um sabor muito bom, e eu dou 3 estrelas porque estou de bom humor. Não é ruim, mas não é o tipo de lugar que eu frequentaria (voltar).
text_en: Honestly, I have no idea what people like about this ice cream. To me, it simply doesn’t have a very good taste. I give it 3 stars because I’m in a good mood. It’s not bad, but it’s not the kind of place I would go back to.
original: Frankly I don't know what people like about it. To me this gelato just doesn't taste very good and I give it 3 stars because I am in a good mood. It's not terrible just not the place I would frequent (come again)

text: Vim aqui em um primeiro encontro e adorei! Funcionários muito simpáticos e sorvete incrível!
text_en: I met them at a first encounter and loved it! The staff are very friendly, and the ice cream is amazing!
original: Came here on a first date and had a great time! Super friendly staff and amazing ice cream!

text: I have been wanting to try this place forever, but I've avoiding it because like ever other local I hate the strip. I was in the Venetian, and accidentally ran into this little gem. I was unprepared, shocked, excited! I knew that I wanted to try the macaroons. At the $3.50 a pop, I could only justify getting one. I settled on my favorite flavor, pistachio, and ordered a chocolate chip cookie as well. The macaroon was overly sweet. To me it tasted like an Andes mint flavored macaroon, so maybe they use mint for color? There was only a subtle hint of pistachio. I was completely disappointed. The macaroons in the freezer section at Walmart are 10 times better. The chocolate chip cookie was okay. The chocolate chips were fantastic, but the cookie was just average. Definitely not something I'd go back for. If you're on the Strip, there are far better options that are more deserving of your money and caloric intake. Skip this one!
text_en: I have been wanting to try this place forever, but I've avoiding it because like ever other local I hate the strip. I was in the Venetian, and accidentally ran into this little gem. I was unprepared, shocked, excited! I knew that I wanted to try the macaroons. At the $3.50 a pop, I could only justify getting one. Definitely not something I'd go back for. If you're on the Strip, there are far better options that are more deserving of your money and caloric intake. Skip this one!

text: This place is amazing! The people are extremely friendly including the owner, all their donuts look delicious and they tasted just as good as they looked! I'm glad I found this place thanks to YouTube.
text_en: This place is amazing! The people are extremely friendly including the owner, all their donuts look delicious and they tasted just as good as they looked! I'm glad I found this place thanks to YouTube.

text: Acho que não há um lugar melhor para comer sobremesas quando se sente vontade, literalmente, a qualquer hora. Sentindo-se mal às 4 da manhã e precisando de algo com caramelo e chocolate? O Amelie's pode ajudar. Quer ouvir música ao vivo e saborear um pão baguette e um chá? O Amelie's oferece música ao vivo em algumas noites. Posso dizer que não experimentei os pratos principais, mas, meu Deus, tenho um grande desejo por doces. Adoro este lugar e sempre voltarei para desfrutar e passar um tempo agradável com amigos, ou até mesmo sozinho.
text_en: I think there’s no better place to eat desserts when you really feel like it, at any time. Feeling unwell at 4 a.m. and needing something with caramel and chocolate? Amelie’s can help. Want to listen to live music and enjoy a baguette and tea? Amelie’s offers live music on some nights. I can’t say I’ve tried the main dishes, but, oh my God, I have a huge craving for sweets. I love this place, and I’ll always come back to enjoy it and spend pleasant time with friends, or even alone.
original: I don't think you can find a better dessert spot to go to when you want to fill your cravings, literally whenever. Feeling blue at 4am and need a caramel and chocolate something or the other? Amelie's has your back. Want to listen to live music and enjoy a baguette and some tea? Amelie's is there with live music on certain nights. I can say I haven't had any of the main dishes, but man, do I have a sweet tooth. I love this place and will always be back to enjoy and have a nice time with friends, or even by myself.

text: I was a little sketchy to try cupcakes as I'm not a fan of super sweet or overly frosted. Decided to stop in and at least try them once. The red velvet and peanut butter chip were amazing! They have many flavor options and offer a sample of 3 minis for $5. Don't be intimated by the frosting. It is way lighter and creamier than it might appear. No fear to take a huge bite and let your mouth indulge! The guy helping me gets extra props as I could not make up mind and had to change my order at the end of my transaction. He never showed his annoyance or impatience with me and honestly I would have been annoyed by my ordering. Worst mistake of my trip would have been not to stop in!

They have many flavor options and offer a sample of 3 minis for $5. Don't be intimated by the frosting. It is way lighter and creamier than it might appear. text: Sorvete incrível, ambiente excelente – adorei este lugar. Durante um fim de semana, fui três vezes! Experimentei o sabor de pistache, chocolate e amendoim, além do sabor de avelã torrada. Todos os sabores que provei estavam realmente deliciosos! É definitivamente um lugar imperdível para quem busca sorvete em Cleveland!
text_en: Incredible ice cream, great atmosphere – I really loved this place. During one weekend, I went three times! I tried the pistachio, chocolate, and peanut flavors, as well as the toasted walnut flavor. All the flavors I tried were truly delicious! It’s definitely a must-visit place for anyone looking for ice cream in Cleveland!
original: Amazing ice cream, great interior - loved this place. Over a weekend I went three times! I tried the pistachio, chocolate and peanut chunk, and toasted hazelnut. All the flavours I sampled were really good! It's definitely a must go-to place for ice cream in Cleveland!

text: Excelente lugar. Adoro o brownie de caramelo salgado, é delicioso, e o café sempre é perfeito. O atendimento é sempre muito atencioso e a atmosfera é incrível.
text_en: Great place. I love the salty caramel brownies—they’re delicious, and the coffee is always perfect. The service is always very attentive, and the atmosphere is incredible.
original: Awesome spot. Love the salted caramel brownie of course and the coffee always hits the spot. Service is always very friendly and you can't beat the atmosphere

text: El helado era muy rico, cremoso y lleno de sabor (probé una porción de "Cookie Wasted"). Además, venía en un recipiente para llevar de estilo chino, ¡incluso con una galleta de la suerte! Mi única decepción fue que no tenía suficiente tiempo/espacio en el estómago para probar todo. Muy recomendado.
text_en: The ice cream was very rich, creamy, and full of flavor (I tried a portion of “Cookie Wasted”). Moreover, it came in a Chinese-style container, even with a lucky cookie inside! My only disappointment was that I didn’t have enough time or space in my stomach to try everything. Highly recommended.
original: The ice cream was very rich, creamy, and full of flavor (I got a single scoop of the Cookie Wasted). In addition, it came in a Chinese take-out container complete with a fortune cookie! My only regret was that I didn't have enough time/stomach space to try everything. Highly recommended.

text: Assim que você entra, parece que viajou no tempo e chegou em um salão de uma pessoa rica. Os bolos têm uma apresentação linda e há uma variedade de bebidas para escolher. A equipe é simpática e se move com cuidado atrás do balcão. Além disso, há um estacionamento logo ao lado (algo incomum em Lawrenceville), o que é um grande diferencial! Seria um ótimo lugar para uma conversa íntima no sofá ou em uma das áreas externas do jardim. Os sabores dos bolos são combinações interessantes que não são geralmente encontrados em padarias convencionais ou supermercados. Tirei uma estrela porque, embora o bolo tenha sido delicioso, era um pouco pesado. A cobertura era leve e sutilmente doce, e as morangos eram frescas. Os preços são semelhantes aos dos sobremesas da Cheesecake Factory. É um ótimo lugar para satisfazer o desejo por doces, e ainda se sentir saudável, já que as sobremesas são veganas.
text_en: As soon as you enter, it feels like you’ve traveled back in time and arrived in a luxurious salon. The cakes are beautifully presented, and there’s a wide variety of drinks to choose from. The staff is friendly and moves around carefully behind the counter. Additionally, there’s a parking lot right next to the place—something unusual in Lawrenceville, which is a great advantage! It’s a great place for a quiet conversation on the sofa or in one of the outdoor areas in the garden. The flavors of the cakes are interesting combinations that aren’t usually found in regular bakeries or supermarkets. I gave it one star because, although the cake was delicious, it was a bit heavy. The topping was light and slightly sweet, and the strawberries were fresh. The prices are similar to those of the desserts at Cheesecake Factory. It’s a great place to satisfy your sweet tooth, and you can still feel healthy since the desserts are vegan.
original: As soon as you walk in, it feels like you've traveled back in time and ended up in a wealthy person's parlor. The cakes have a beautiful display and there are a variety of drinks to choose from. The staff are friendly and move carefully behind the counter. There is also a parking lot right next door (unusual in lawrenceville), big plus! This would be a great place for an intimate conversation on the sofa or at one of the outdoor garden areas. The cake flavors are interesting combinations that aren't generally offered at grocery store or barebones bakeries. I took away a star because although the cake was yummy, it was a bit heavy. The cream was airy and subtly sweet, and the strawberries were fresh. The prices are similar to Cheesecake Factory dessert prices. This is a great spot to satisfy your sweet tooth and feel healthy doing it as the desserts are vegan.

text: Tuve que ir solo para ver de qué se trataba todo el revuelo, y efectivamente, es así. Era bueno, con ingredientes de calidad y una presentación muy atractiva. Pero el sabor, en el mejor de los casos, es mediocre. Se pueden encontrar cupcakes e ingredientes para glasear mucho mejores en otras pastelerías. Los cupcakes no cumplieron con las expectativas generadas por el revuelo. No hay nada malo o incorrecto en la comida, simplemente no esperaría esperar en una fila tan larga por ese nivel de sabor. Los pasteles tienen una presentación asombrosa, pero no un sabor igualmente sorprendente.
text_en: I had to go alone to see what all the fuss was about, and indeed, it was just like that. It was good, with high-quality ingredients and a very attractive presentation. But the taste, at best, is mediocre. There are much better cupcakes and frosting ingredients available at other bakeries. The cupcakes didn’t meet the expectations that the hype created. There’s nothing wrong or incorrect with the food itself; I simply wouldn’t expect to wait in such a long line for that level of taste. The cakes have an amazing presentation, but not a similarly impressive taste.
original: Had to go just to see what all the hype is about and that is exactly what it is. It was good, with quality ingredients and a beautiful look. But the taste is average at best. Better cupcakes and icings to be had at several other bakeries. The cupcakes just did not live up to the hype and expectations. Nothing bad or wrong with the food, I just wouldn't wait in a line that long for that quality of taste. The cakes have an amazing look, not an amazing taste.

text: I came here every week overall I enjoyed the environment and service every time but I had a bad experience today. I feel like I'm not respected by the barista/cashier - Jesse (that's what she told me not sure if she made it up). I'd like some milk for my dripped coffee but she did not seem like to help me with it. She was reluctant to get me the milk but instead trying to have me used the cream on the table. That is not something I need and when I insist on getting the milk, she took the milk out from the fridge with a lot of aversion on her face. I feel like being discriminated as she treats other caucasian customers with a MUCH MORE friendly manner. I feel like your store needs an ethical training especially for Jesse.

text: Às 21h30, tivemos uma espera de 20 minutos para ser atendidos, então estávamos curiosos para descobrir o que tornava esses sorvetes tão especiais. Não planeje sua ordem com antecedência, pois eles não têm todos os sabores do cardápio. Então, optei pelo sorvete de coco tostado com marshmallow e Reese's. Estava delicioso. O sorvete de coco tostado tinha um sabor muito intenso de coco, e eu conseguia sentir o coco ralado através do sorvete. A atmosfera e as mesas ao ar livre lembram um local de encontro na faculdade. É um ambiente social simples. No geral, um ótimo lugar, com apenas uma ressalva: o sorvete de coco tostado não era a minha primeira escolha, e o local não tinha todos os sabores mencionados no cardápio! Mas é um lugar que todos deveriam visitar pelo menos uma vez.
text_en: At 9:30 p.m., we waited for 20 minutes before being served. We were curious to find out what made these ice creams so special. Don’t plan your order in advance, as they don’t have all the flavors listed on the menu. So, I chose roasted coconut ice cream with marshmallows and Reese’s. It was delicious. The roasted coconut ice cream had a very strong coconut flavor, and I could feel the grated coconut through the ice cream. The atmosphere and the outdoor tables remind me of a college party spot. It’s a simple social environment. Overall, it’s a great place—with one caveat: roasted coconut ice cream wasn’t my first choice, and the place didn’t have all the flavors mentioned on the menu! But it’s a place everyone should visit at least once.
original: At 930 pm we had a 20 min wait to get in our order, so we were really curious as to finding out what was so special about these ice creams. Don't plan your order beforehand as they do not have all the flavors from their menu. So I ended up taking the toasted coconut ice cream with toasted marshmallow fluff and Reese's. It was delicious. The toasted coconut ice cream was very coconutty and I could taste the shredded coconut through the ice cream. The ambience and outdoor seating reminds me of a college hangout area. It's a simple social setting. Overall a great place minus one because toasted coconut wasn't my first preference and the place did not have all the flavors mentioned in the menu! But a place everyone should visit at least once.

text: Doces deliciosos... ou talvez sejam bons porque estamos bêbados quando vamos lá... haha... mas falando sério, é um ótimo lugar para ir.
text_en: Delicious treats... or maybe they’re good because we’re drunk when we go there... haha... but seriously, it’s a great place to go.
original: Good Desserts....or may be good because we are drunk when we go there...lol...but seriously Good place to go

text: Había escuchado muchas cosas sobre este lugar y estaba deseando probar un macaron. El local es una panadería y hay otro restaurante al otro lado del hotel... pedí el de chocolate, que era más grande que un macaron normal, y estaba deseando probarlo... el macaron está bien, pero sigo prefiriendo Bottega Louie. Creo que mis expectativas eran demasiado altas, y además me divertí mucho sosteniendo un macaron tan grande. Volveré para probar otros productos de la panadería, que espero que sean aún mejores.
text_en: I had heard many things about this place, and I really wanted to try a macaron. The establishment is a bakery, and there’s another restaurant across from the hotel… I ordered the chocolate one; it was bigger than a regular macaron, and I was eager to try it… The macaron itself is fine, but I still prefer Bottega Louie. I guess my expectations were too high. Besides, I really enjoyed holding such a big macaron in my hands. I will come back to try other products from the bakery; hopefully they will be even better.
original: I had heard a lot about this place and was eager to get my hands on a macaron. The location is a bakery and there's another restaurant on the other side of the hotel... I got the chocolate one which was bigger than your average macaron and was very eager to bite into it...the macaron is good but i still prefer bottega louie. I think my expectations were too high coupled with my amusement of holding an oversized macaron. I'll be back to try their other bakery items which will hopefully be better.

text: Essas cupcakes tinham uma aparência muito bonita, mas estavam extremamente secas. A cobertura estava ótima! Pena que o "Cupcake Boss" não tenha mantido a mesma qualidade, pois os cupcakes ficaram ruins!
text_en: These cupcakes looked very beautiful, but they were extremely dry. The frosting was great! It’s a pity that “Cupcake Boss” didn’t maintain the same quality, because the cupcakes turned out bad!
original: These cupcakes were so pretty looking bit very dry as Hell. The icing was Awesome! Too Bad Cupcake Boss but your Cupcakes Sucks!!

text: Así que, si están en el hotel Cosmopolitan, tienen que probar este lugar. ¡Son los mejores batidos que he probado en mucho tiempo! Mis favoritos son los "quake shakes". Probé el de chocolate con sal marina y dulce, y estaba increíble. También pedí un "quake pie" (que hay que solicitarlo), y también fue excelente. Los recomiendo mucho y volveré aquí.
text_en: So, if you’re at the Cosmopolitan Hotel, you definitely need to try this place. It’s the best smoothies I’ve had in a long time! My favorites are the “Quake Shakes”. I tried the chocolate with sea salt and sugar one, and it was amazing. I also ordered a “Quake Pie” (you have to order it), and it was also excellent. I highly recommend it, and I’ll be back here again.
original: Okay so you have to try this place at the Cosmopolitan hotel. Best shakes I've had in a while. The quake shakes are my favorite. I tried the chocolate sea salt dulce and it was out of this world. I also had a crack pie quake( you have to special request) and it was also a 10. I highly recommend and will come here again.

text: 2 Largas colas. Pedimos un pastel de cumpleaños y tuvimos que esperar bastante tiempo en la fila, unos 20 minutos, para recogerlo. Además, tuvimos que aparcar y caminar un kilómetro. No estaba empaquetado y el horario de recogida era a las 5. Eran casi las 7. Los pisos y todas las superficies de cristal estaban sucios. Demasiado fondant y demasiado caro. Definitivamente no volvería allí.
text_en: 2 Long queues. We ordered a birthday cake and had to wait for quite a while in line—about 20 minutes—to pick it up. In addition, we had to park the car and walk a kilometer. It wasn’t packaged properly, and the pickup time was at 5 o’clock. It was almost 7 o’clock by then. The floors and all the glass surfaces were dirty. Too much fondant, and too expensive. Definitely not going back there.
original: 2 Massive lines , we ordered a birthday cake and had to wait a while in line 20 minutes to get it. Not to mention park and walk A mile. It wasn't boxed up and scheduled to be picked up at 5. It was almost 7. Floors and all glass was dirty. Too much fondant and too expensive. No way I'd go back there

text: Wishing this was a fivestar-er, but man we're bummed. It was hard to find this place at night, no illuminated signage. Once we found it, we were pumped and the girl who welcomed us in was nice. Unfortunately, although we were the only people there... And the only people in the parking lot.. Repeating myself here this joint was not busy, pretty much everything we came for was sold out. The marshmallow you see in every picture on Yelp? Sold Out. What bothers me about that? How do you run out of your signature item, especially when it's (I'm assuming here) not homemade. Go to the grocery store, buy mallows. Problem solved. Same with the red velvet macaroons. I happened to order the last one, leaving my boyfriend to pick from the remaining flavors (Carmel was also sold out). Ice cream flavors were good and the macaroon was tasty, but for $11+ dollars?! No. Especially with the inconvenience of ordering from a limited menu and the atmosphere being kinda meh. Just... No.

text_en: Clean, organized, and delicious… Download the app to receive daily/monthly updates on new flavors. Excellent customer service. They also have a dessert shop, which is fantastic.
original: Clean, Neat, Tasty... Download the app for daily/monthly updates on New Flavors. Great customer service The have an Ice Cream store attached, which is Awesome

text: It's familiar name to long-time Arizonans with a new home downtown. Great ice cream. Great service. I'm not sure what else you need--unless it's their pie, too.
text_en: It's familiar name to long-time Arizonans with a new home downtown. Great ice cream. Great service. I'm not sure what else you need--unless it's their pie, too.

text: ¡Qué lugar tan divertido! Los cupcakes se venden individualmente O a través de un "autómata de cupcakes". También puedes esperar en la fila (la fila era relativamente rápida) para obtener helado, sándwiches de helado o galletas. Mi hija se comió helado de "red velvet" entre un cupcake de "red velvet" y uno blanco. Dijo que era delicioso. Éramos un grupo grande y todos fueron muy amables, pacientes y atentos. ¿Volvería? Absolutamente. ¿Me esforzaría para probar esto? No. PERO, todo el centro donde está la noria de Linq es imprescindible, así que si ya estás allí, definitivamente vale la pena probarlo.
text_en: What a fun place! The cupcakes are sold individually or through a “cupcake automaton”. You can also wait in line (the line was relatively short) to get ice cream, ice cream sandwiches, or cookies. My daughter ate red velvet ice cream between one red velvet and one white cupcake. She said it was delicious. We were a large group, and everyone was very friendly, patient, and attentive. Would I go back? Definitely. Would I try this out? No. BUT, the whole area with the Linq Ferris wheel is essential, so if you’re already there, it’s definitely worth trying.
original: What a fun place!!! Cupcakes are sold a la carte OR from a "cupcake ATM!" You can also wait in a line (line was relatively fast) for ice cream, ice cream sandwiches or cookies. My daughter had red velvet ice cream in between a red velvet cupcake top and white cupcake top. She said it was heaven. We were a big group and they were all very sweet, patient and accommodating. Would I come back? Absolutely. Would I go out of my way to get this checked off the list? No. BUT, the whole center where the Linq Ferris Wheel is a must--so if you are already there, then it's a must try.

text: Acabo de llegar de Long Island y decidí parar a tomar algo rápido. Desde el café hasta los sándwiches y los pasteles, se nota que todo está hecho con ingredientes frescos y con mucho cariño. Estoy deseando volver a visitarlos.
text_en: I just got back from Long Island, and I decided to stop by for something quick to eat. From the coffee to the sandwiches and pastries, it’s clear that everything is made with fresh ingredients and with great care. I can’t wait to visit them again.
original: Just came in from Long Island, decided to stop by for a quick bite. From the coffee to the sandwiches to the pastries you can tell everything was made fresh and with love. Can't wait to visit again.

text: Muito caro para o que oferece. Não há dúvidas de que é um doce delicioso. Os biscoitos de açúcar têm o sabor que sempre sonhei. Mas, depois de comprar dois combos dos mais vendidos, me sinto um pouco ingênuo. Uma sacola tão pequena com uma quantidade minúscula de guloseimas por apenas US$ 50. Sei que estou em Las Vegas, mas isso é um pouco exagerado. Tenho certeza de que posso encontrar lugares com preços semelhantes.
text_en: It’s very expensive for what it offers. There’s no doubt it’s a delicious treat. The sugar cookies have the flavor I’ve always dreamed of. But after buying two combos of the most popular items, I feel a bit naive. A such small bag with such a tiny amount of snacks for just $50. I know I’m in Las Vegas, but that seems a bit exaggerated. I’m sure I can find places with similar prices.
original: Very overpriced for what it is. No doubt that this is indeed good dessert. The compost cookie has the flavor of my dreams. But after getting two bestseller combos I feel like a fool. Such a tiny small bag with tiny portion of goodies for $50. I know it is Vegas and all but this is just a bit too much. I am sure I can find place just as good for a portion of the price.

text: Voy allí con frecuencia, pero últimamente he tenido malas experiencias. Hoy fui y compré galletas, pero estaban tan duras y rancias que no pude creerlo. La próxima vez que vaya, les haré saber lo que pasó. Me alegro de no haber comprado lo que iba a comprar.
text_en: I go there frequently, but lately I’ve had bad experiences. Today I went and bought cookies, but they were so hard and stale that I couldn’t believe it. Next time I go, I’ll let them know what happened. I’m glad I didn’t buy what I was about to buy.
original: I go there a lot but lately I've been really getting bad I went there and got cookies today the cookies were so hard old nasty I couldn't believe it next time I go I will let them know now I'm glad I didn't buy what I was going to buy

text: Não posso reclamar da qualidade dos produtos, pois a padaria não é tão ruim assim... mas o atendimento é péssimo. Eu pedi um bolo e as instruções dizem para ir direto para a retirada, o que eu fiz. No entanto, nenhum funcionário, desde o caixa até aquele que preparava as bebidas, nem sequer notou minha presença enquanto eu estava ali. Fiquei na fila até que alguém me ajudasse, e mesmo assim, o pedido não estava pronto no horário combinado. Além disso, parecia que eu não tinha feito a encomenda. Mostrei o comprovante, mas o funcionário responsável pelo meu pedido parecia confuso e não agiu com iniciativa. No final, o atendimento foi terrível.
text_en: I can’t complain about the quality of the products, because the bakery isn’t that bad… but the service is terrible. I ordered a cake, and the instructions say to go straight to the pickup area, which I did. However, no employee—from the cashier to those who prepared the drinks—noticed my presence at all while I was there. I waited in line until someone helped me, yet the order wasn’t ready by the agreed time. It also seemed like I hadn’t made the order at all. I showed the receipt, but the employee responsible for my order seemed confused and didn’t take any initiative. In the end, the service was absolutely horrible.
original: Not knocking them on their food, cause it's not that bad of a bakery.. but the service is terrible I orderered a cake and in the instructions it says to go straight to the pick up, which I did, every associate from the cashier to whoever was making the drinks didn't once even acknowledge me just standing there. I stood in line until someone helped me and they didn't even have my order ready at the specific time, and even made it seem like I didn't order at all, I showed them the reciept and whoever was looking into my order was acting clueless and didn't move with a purpose. At the end of the day, terrible service.

text: ¿Qué más puedo decir que ya no se ha dicho? Churn elabora helados clásicos y deliciosos, con sabores únicos y modernos. Me encanta la tienda, con todos los dulces nostálgicos, y el pequeño oasis con patio en la parte trasera. Como vivo en las afueras, el estacionamiento me estresa, pero me gusta que tengan un espacio de estacionamiento de 15 minutos justo en la entrada, así que si solo voy a comprar un helado (en lugar de cenar en Windsor), puedo entrar y salir fácilmente.
text_en: What else can I say that hasn’t been said already? Churn makes classic and delicious ice creams with unique and modern flavors. I love the store, with all those nostalgic sweets, and the small courtyard in the back. Since I live in the suburbs, parking can be stressful, but I like that they have a 15-minute parking space right at the entrance. So, if I just want to buy an ice cream (instead of dining in Windsor), I can easily enter and leave.
original: What else can I say that hasn't already been said? Churn makes really great old fashioned ice cream with some unique, modern flavors. Love the cute shop with all the nostalgic candy and the little patio oasis out back. Since I live in the 'burbs the parking stresses me out but I love that they have the 15 minute parking right up front so if you are just stopping in to get a cone (rather than having dinner at Windsor) you can get in and out easily.

text: We closed an evening out with a stop at this open all night bakery. I couldn't believe how many people were waiting in line, but this had to be a good sign, right? The line moved very quickly just as the decisions on what to try had to be made fast. There were 4 of us and together we purchased two vanilla eclairs, two coconut macaroons, chocolate cream puff and raspberry chocolate tart along with fresh brewed coffee. I thought the prices were very reasonable considering the quality. I was told the salted caramel brownies are very popular. The French bohemian decor with mismatched tables, chairs, and odd assortment of pictures on the walls adds to the vibe. Definitely worth stopping in to give yourself a treat.

text: ¡Me encanta este lugar! Podría ser mi cafetería favorita en todo Estados Unidos. La comida era deliciosa y el café estaba bastante bien. Sin embargo, el ambiente y la atmósfera son increíbles. Se encuentra en un punto entre lo kitsch y lo encantador de forma ecléctica. Podría pasar todo el día aquí, ¡hay tantos rincones maravillosos para descubrir!
text_en: I love this place! It could be my favorite café in all of the United States. The food was delicious, and the coffee was quite good too. However, the atmosphere and ambiance are incredible. It’s a place that combines both kitschy and charming elements in a wonderful way. I could spend all day here—there are so many amazing spots to explore!
original: I absolutely adore this place! This may be my favorite coffee shop in the entire U.S. The food was delicious and the coffee was pretty good. The vibe and ambience however is amazing. It borders between kitsch and eclectically cute. I could spend all day here--there are so many amazing little nooks to discover.

text: Tenía amigos visitando en la ciudad y quería llevarlos a un lugar tranquilo con buena comida, así que fui a Amelie's en Noda. Me encanta que este lugar esté abierto las 24 horas y que ofrezcan WiFi gratuito y un área de patio abierta. Además, tienen una gran variedad de postres y pasteles. Cada vez que necesito una merienda por la noche... este es mi lugar favorito.
text_en: I had friends visiting in town, and I wanted to take them to a quiet place with good food. So I went to Amelie’s in Noda. I love that this place is open 24 hours a day, offers free Wi-Fi, and has an open patio area. They also have a wide variety of desserts and cakes. Whenever I need a snack at night… this is my favorite place.
original: I had friends visiting in town and wanted to take them to a chill spot with good treats, so I went to Amelie's in Noda. I love that this place is open 24 hours and they have free WiFi and an opened courtyard area. Not to mention they have a huge selection of desserts and pastries. Whenever I want a late night snack.... this is my go to spot.

text: O melhor sorvete que já experimentei! Sabores deliciosos, atendimento excelente. Eu sei reconhecer um bom sorvete, e este é o melhor. Se você estiver em Cleveland, não pode perder!
text_en: The best ice cream I’ve ever tried! Delicious flavors, excellent service. I know how to recognize good ice cream, and this is the best one. If you’re in Cleveland, you definitely shouldn’t miss it!
original: Straight up the best ice cream ever ! Great flavors , nice staff . I know good ice cream and this is it . If your in Cleveland it's a must .

text: Experimentei os macarons deles, mas não fiquei muito impressionado (e, considerando a quantidade de comentários positivos aqui, acho que fiquei desapontado).
text_en: I tried their macarons, but I wasn’t very impressed (and considering the number of positive comments here, I guess I was disappointed).
original: Tried their macarons, wasn't impressed (and given the number of raving reviews here I'd say I was disappointed).

text: O tio Bryan veio de Los Angeles para a cerimônia de casamento da família. Este foi um elogio especial para o Mitchell's, enviado para o sobrinho Alex... Sinto que você está um pouco invejoso, Alex, o que é compreensível, considerando que é o melhor sorveteria do mundo. Já visitei o lugar duas vezes e tenho uma camiseta. Detalhes: Primeira visita em 22 de julho. Fiquei impressionado com o ambiente teatral, a luz abundante que vinha de todas as janelas, o atendimento atencioso, os inúmeros garfos e a limpeza geral do interior. Um pouco sobrecarregado com a variedade, experimentei o sorvete de mel e lavanda de Lena, que era delicado e delicioso. Morango com pimenta? Que audácia. Optei pelo sorvete de creme de banana e fiquei maravilhado com as bananas frescas e o fio de marshmallow caseiro. E espere, tem uma base de biscoito caseiro no sorvete? Sim, tem. Neste ponto, é um dos meus lugares de sorvete favoritos. Em seguida, fui levado para o andar de cima, onde pude observar os funcionários trabalhando alegremente em uma cozinha impecável, através de uma grande janela – cortando biscoitos, brownies. Incrível. Tirei aquela foto do pôr do sol. Sentamos nas mesas de piquenique e aproveitamos os momentos felizes do verão. 24 de julho. O renomado crítico gastronômico Xavi comparece, e fotos dele comendo sorvete de amendoim são enviadas para mim. Viagem II: Pós-casamento, 25 de julho. Retorno com os sobrinhos e Topher. Como sempre, o pistache era meu sorvete favorito, então experimentei o pistache torrado. Delicioso. Os sobrinhos ficam maravilhados ao receberem uma porção grande de sorvete, que preenche um cone de waffle. Observamos o ambiente de trabalho. Mesmo com a influência do White Claw, os sobrinhos ficam impressionados. Menciono na frente a leve decepção com o fato de o trem não estar funcionando. E o atendente aciona o interruptor, e o trem começa a se mover. Os sobrinhos negam ter sido relutantes. Minha única reclamação é que a camiseta não é grande, ou então eu tenho muitas camisetas do Mitchell's.
text_en: Uncle Bryan came from Los Angeles for the family wedding ceremony. This was a special compliment for Mitchell’s, sent to my nephew Alex… I feel like you’re a little jealous, Alex—which is understandable, considering it’s the best ice cream shop in the world. I’ve been there twice already, and I even have a T-shirt from it. Details: First visit was on July 22nd. I was impressed by the theatrical atmosphere, the abundant light coming from all the windows, the attentive service, the countless forks, and the overall cleanliness inside. It was a bit overwhelming with all the options; I tried Lena’s honey and lavender ice cream—delicious and delicate. Strawberry with pepper? How daring! I chose banana cream ice cream, and I was amazed by the fresh bananas and homemade marshmallow strands. And wait—there’s also homemade cookie base in the ice cream? Yes, there is. This is one of my favorite ice cream spots. Then I was taken upstairs, where I could see the staff working happily in a flawless kitchen through a big window—cutting cookies, brownies. Amazing. I took that sunset photo. We sat at picnic tables and enjoyed those happy summer moments. July 24th. The renowned food critic Xavi attends, and photos of him eating peanut ice cream are sent to me. Trip II: After the wedding, July 25th. Back with the nephews and Topher. As always, pistachio was my favorite ice cream—so I tried roasted pistachio ice cream. Delicious. The nephews are thrilled to get a big portion of ice cream to fill a waffle cone. We observed the work environment. Even with the influence of White Claw, the nephews are still impressed. I mention the slight disappointment that the train isn’t working. But the attendant turns on the switch, and the train starts moving. The nephews deny being reluctant. My only complaint is that the T-shirt isn’t big enough, or maybe I have too many T-shirts from Mitchell’s.
original: Uncle Bryan came into Cleveland from LA for family wedding. This was his ode to Mitchell's, sent to nephew Alex.... I'm sensing a little bit of jealousy there Alex, which is understandable for the best ice cream place IN THE WORLD. I'm at two visits and own one t-shirt. Break down: FIrst visit July 22. Wowed by theater-setting, the abundant light from all-encompassing windows, the warm customer service, unlimited spoons and overall cleanliness and well-lit interior. Slightly dizzyby the selection, I tried Lena's lavender honey which was delicate and beautiful. Strawberry jalapeno? The audacity. I went with banana cream pie, and was mesmerized by the fresh bananas, the homemade marshmallow ribbon. And wait, is that homemade shortbread crust in the ice cream. Why yes it. At this point, it is among my top ice cream places ever. Then I am led to the upstairs, where I can watch workers happily working in a spotless kitchen fromalarge window - cutting up shortbread, brownies. Amazing. I took that picture of the setting sun. We sit on picnic benches and enjoy blissful moments of high summer. July 24. Notoriously discerning food critic Xavi attends, and pictures of his utter happiness eating peanut butter ice cream are sent to me. Trip II: Post wedding July 25. I return with reluctant nephews and Topher. Having always placed pistachio as my go-to ice cream, I make the plunge with toasted pistachio. Explosions. Eben marvels as he is given an Eben-sized single scoop filling a waffle cone. We take in the workplace window of joy. Even through the haze of White Claw, the nephews are impressed. I mention at the front slight disappointment that the train is not working. And the guy behind the counter hits the switch, and the train starts moving. Nephews deny ever being reluctant. My only quibble is that t-shirt is not a large, either that or I have one too many Mitchell's.

text: Pasteles excelentes. Algunos de los mejores croissants y pain au chocolat que hemos probado desde Francia. Los demás pasteles también son deliciosos. Tenga en cuenta que están cerrados los lunes.
text_en: Excellent pastries. Some of the best croissants and chocolate bread we’ve tried since France. The other pastries are also delicious too. Note that they are closed on Mondays.
original: Excellent pastries. Some of the best croissants and pain au chocolat we've had since France. Other pastries are also delicious! Note they are closed on Mondays.

text: Eu já comi Kouign-Amman muito melhores, e o preço era bem mais baixo. A parte externa não era crocante e furada, e o interior não tinha a maciez que encontro em outras versões melhores. Os beignets estavam ok, o recheio foi a melhor parte, e o café tinha um gosto estranho. No geral, foi bom, mas não valeu o preço pago.
text_en: I’ve eaten much better Kouign-Amman before, and the price was much lower. The outer part wasn’t crispy or hollow, and the interior didn’t have the softness I find in other better versions. The beignets were okay, the filling was the best part, but the coffee had a strange taste. Overall, it was good, but it wasn’t worth the price paid.
original: I've had way better Kouign-Amman and it didn't cost near as much. The outside was not flaky and crisp and the inside lacked the softness I find in other, better versions. The beignets were okay, the filling was the best part, and the coffee tasted off. Overall, it was decent but not worth the money spent.

text: Nunca decepciona. ¡Pide el cono con gofres! Siempre hay una fila, así que si visitas desde fuera de la ciudad, es una buena idea ir un día de semana. Te permiten probar algunos sabores, así que te recomendaría hacerlo antes de decidirte. ¡El sabor de arándanos es siempre una excelente opción!
text_en: It never disappoints. Order the cone with pastries! There’s always a line, so if you visit from outside the city, it’s a good idea to go on a weekday. They allow you to try out several flavors, so I recommend going before you make up your mind. The raspberry flavor is always an excellent choice!
original: Never disappoints. Get the waffle Cone! Always a line so trying to come on a weekday if you are visiting from out of town is a solid decision. They let you try a flavor or two so I would do so before committing. The brickleberry is always a great choice!

text: Gran ambiente – Me encanta la comida/postres, disponible las 24 horas del día.
text_en: Great atmosphere – I love the food and desserts; they are available 24 hours a day.
original: Great atmosphere - 24/7 love the food/Dessert

text: Todos os meus lugares favoritos em Los Angeles finalmente estão em Las Vegas; o 85°C é um deles. É apenas um passeio de 25 minutos da minha casa; muito melhor do que as 4 horas. Que legal!! Agora, uma lista de vantagens e desvantagens para facilitar as coisas para mim e para quem estiver lendo isso. Vantagens: 1. Claro, todos os deliciosos, macios e fofinhos doces. Os meus preferidos são o brioche, o boroh danish, o pão de rolo com taro, a torta de queijo Hokkaido e o pão de coco. E o meu namorado gosta de todos os sabores salgados; jalapeño e cream cheese, pães de cachorro-quente, salsicha picante e presunto com queijo. 2. Devido à COVID-19, todos os doces já vêm embalados individualmente. Eu acho que isso é muito mais fácil do que a forma antiga. Com tudo já embalado, você não precisa esperar muito na fila para que o caixa, com as mãos sujas, embale todos os seus doces um por um. 3. Eu adoro o café deles com espuma de sal marinho!! É muito bom e te dá um bom impulso para o dia. Desvantagens: 1. Está localizado no Chinatown. Eu não gosto do Chinatown. As pessoas não podem dirigir e a Spring Mountain é péssima. Está localizado em um novo centro comercial movimentado, então boa sorte em encontrar uma vaga de estacionamento nos fins de semana. 2. Por que este lugar é tão pequeno?!? Todos os outros locais que visitei em Los Angeles foram muito maiores e espaçosos. Considerando todo o dinheiro que eles ganham, você pensaria que poderiam se dar ao luxo de ter um espaço maior. 3. Falando em espaços pequenos, esqueça a distância social. Com os clientes constantemente se movendo e olhando para todos os pães, você está literalmente ao lado de alguém o tempo todo. E, claro, tem aquele cliente que não tem noção do espaço e leva 19 anos para se afastar. 4. A fila fica muito longa rapidamente, e, claro, o cliente não muito esperto não sabe onde ir e entra na frente de todos. Por que as pessoas são tão desatentas?!?! *suspira exasperadamente. Claro, farei o trajeto até o odiado Chinatown por este lugar. E, se você não gosta do 85°, tudo bem. Menos pessoas atrapalhando. Obrigado, tchau!
text_en:
All my favorite places in Los Angeles are finally here in Las Vegas—including the 85°C. It’s just a 25-minute drive from my house; much better than the 4 hours it takes. Cool!! Now, here’s a list of pros and cons to help me and anyone reading this make an informed decision.  

**Pros:**  
1. Of course, all the delicious, soft, and cute desserts. My favorites are brioche, boroh Danish, taro roll bread, Hokkaido cheese cake, and coconut bread. My partner loves all the spicy flavors—jalapeño and cream cheese, hot dog buns, spicy sausage, and ham with cheese.  
2. Due to COVID-19, all desserts come packaged individually. I think this is much easier than the old way. With everything packaged, you don’t have to wait in line for the cashier to pack your desserts one by one, with dirty hands.  
3. I really love their coffee with sea salt foam!! It’s great and gives you a good boost for the day.  

**Cons:**  
1. It’s located in Chinatown. I don’t like Chinatown. People can’t drive there, and Spring Mountain is terrible. It’s in a new, busy shopping center, so good luck finding a parking spot on weekends.  
2. Why is this place so small?! All the other places I’ve visited in Los Angeles were much larger and more spacious. Considering how much they earn, you would think they could afford a bigger space.  
3. Speaking of small spaces, forget about social distance. Customers keep moving around and looking at all the breads, so you’re literally next to someone all the time. And sure, there’s that customer who doesn’t realize how small the space is and takes 19 years to move away.  
4. The line gets very long quickly, and obviously, the careless customer doesn’t know where to go and stands in front of everyone. Why are people so careless?!?! *suspires exasperatedly.* Of course, I’ll go to the hated Chinatown just because of this place. And if you don’t like 85°C, that’s fine. Less people messing up. Thanks, bye!

text: Uma sobremesa deliciosa em um dia quente! A equipe foi muito amigável e prestativa – nos ofereceram uma amostra e nos permitiram fazer o pedido um pouco antes da abertura.

text: Simplesmente pedi o sorvete de leite de cereal com flocos de milho e foi delicioso! text_en: I simply ordered the cereal milk ice cream with corn flakes, and it was delicious! It’s a bit expensive—about $7 for a small portion. But 1) we’re in Las Vegas, where everything is expensive, and 2) anyway, I don’t need a whole gallon of ice cream to satisfy my sweet tooth. But congratulations on the flavor—it’s practically the closest thing to a cereal dish, beyond just the dish itself! I really liked the corn flakes at the bottom; they really enhance the theme! The ice cream also had a buttery taste—and in a very good way!
original: Simply had the cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes and it was so interesting! A bit expensive for over $7 for quite a small cup, but 1) we're in Vegas where EVERYTHING is expensive, and 2) I don't need a gallon of ice cream to satisfy my sweet tooth anyway. But bravo on the flavor--quite literally the closest thing to the bottom of a cereal bowl besides the ACTUAL bottom of a cereal bowl! I like the added corn flakes at the bottom to really bring the theme home! The soft serve tasted buttery too--in a very good way!

text: Bastante bom. Os donuts eram um pouco "sofisticados" para o meu gosto, mas eu voltaria.

text: Rewind has a trendy look, but the beauty isn't just skin deep. This is my go to boba place when I'm in Chandler. Layered drinks like the rose milk latte aren't just eye-catching on Instagram-- they're also delicious! I've tried their milk tea and their fruity tea, and they do both well. I would definitely bring anyone here, because they serve things like ice cream and can please people who don't like/aren't willing to try boba. It's also a little cheaper than some other boba places around here. Every time I've been here, the staff have been exceptionally nice. That, coupled with how quickly they make drinks, is what really makes them a five star establishment in my eyes. They also have a good variety of flavors, including non dairy and caffeine free choices, and the ability to customize sugar levels. Someday I'll get ice cream here, but their tea is so good that I haven't been able to not order it!

text: Me decepcionó mucho no haber tenido la oportunidad de probar este lugar cuando estuve visitando Nueva York, ya que este lugar aparece en casi todos los artículos que incluyen frases como: "25 cosas que debes comer antes de morir en Nueva York". Por eso, me alegró mucho saber que se había abierto una sucursal en Las Vegas, un lugar donde visito con mucha más frecuencia que en Nueva York. Resulta que no estaba perdiendo nada. Probé el helado de leche de cereal con trozos de cereal, el pastel de "crack", la galleta de compost, la galleta de malvavisco con copos de maíz y la galleta de maíz. El helado de leche de cereal estaba bien; no era demasiado dulce, y realmente sabía a leche con cereal remojado. Pero no es algo que anhelara volver a probar. El pastel de "crack" – Lamentablemente, este pastel no cumplió con su nombre. Estaba seco por fuera, blando por dentro y terriblemente dulce. Imaginen cómo sabría una galleta hecha con mantequilla y una cantidad excesiva de azúcar... Sí. Todas las galletas – Extremadamente secas y demasiado dulces. Además, todos estos productos tienen un precio muy elevado. (El helado y el pastel de "crack" costaban $6 cada uno, y las galletas alrededor de $3 cada una). En general, el helado vale la pena probarlo una vez. No vale la pena comprar el pastel o las galletas.
text_en: I was very disappointed not having the opportunity to try this place when I visited New York, as it appears in almost all articles that mention things like “25 things you should eat before dying in New York”. So, I was glad to hear that a branch has opened in Las Vegas, a place I visit much more often than in New York. It turns out I wasn’t losing anything. I tried the cereal milk ice cream with cereal pieces, the “crack” cake, the compost cookie, the marshmallow cookie with cornflakes, and the cornflake cookie. The cereal milk ice cream was good; it wasn’t too sweet, and really tasted like milk with soaked cereal. But it’s not something I would want to try again. The “crack” cake – Unfortunately, this cake didn’t live up to its name. It was dry on the outside, soft inside, and extremely sweet. Imagine how a cookie made with butter and too much sugar would taste… Yes. All the cookies were extremely dry and too sweet. Moreover, all these products are very expensive. (The ice cream and “crack” cake cost $6 each, and the cookies cost around $3 each.) In general, the ice cream is worth trying once. It’s not worth buying the cake or cookies.
original: I was really bummed that I didn't get a chance to check this place out when I was visiting NYC, as this place is mentioned in pretty much every article that goes something like, "25 things you must eat before you die in NYC." So I was thrilled to find out that a location opened in Vegas, a place where I visit much more frequently than NYC. Turns out that I wasn't missing out much. I tried the cereal milk soft serve w/ cereal crunch, crack pie, compost cookie, cornflake marshmallow cookie, and corn cookie. Cereal milk soft serve was nice; it wasn't too sweet, and it indeed tasted like milk where cereal had been soaked in. But it's not something that I would crave again. Crack pie - Sadly, this pie did not live up to its name at all. It was dry on the outside, mushy on the inside, and sickeningly sweet. Just imagine what baked butter with a crap ton of sugar would taste like... Yep. All the cookies - Super dry & way too sweet. Not to mention that all of these items are overpriced. (Soft serve & crack pie were both $6 , the cookies were something like $3 each) All in all, the soft serve is worth trying once. Don't bother getting the pie or the cookies.

text: Paré en su puesto en el West Side Market para comprar un cupcake, y luego vine aquí para conseguir palomitas de maíz y nueces de Brasil. El cupcake era increíble, de sabor a lima. Normalmente no soy muy fan de los cupcakes densos, pero este era suave y tenía un sabor delicioso. El glaseado era dulce, pero con un toque ácido. Las palomitas de maíz (probé las de frutas y me encantaron) estaban deliciosas. Las nueces de Brasil eran simplemente perfectas para mí. (¡Mi hermana las hace mejores!) En general, definitivamente vale la pena una visita. :)
text_en: I went to the West Side Market to buy a cupcake, and then came here for popcorn and Brazil nuts. The cupcake was incredible—with a lime flavor. Usually, I’m not a big fan of dense cupcakes, but this one was soft and had a delicious taste. The icing was sweet, but with a slight sour note. The popcorn (I tried the fruit-flavored ones and loved them) was delicious. The Brazil nuts were simply perfect for me. (My sister makes them even better!) Overall, definitely worth a visit. :)
original: I stopped by their stand in the West Side Market for a cupcake, and later came here to get popcorn and buckeyes. The cupcake was amazing--key lime. I'm not usually a fan of dense cupcakes, but this one was moist and tasted great. The frosting was sweet but a little tangy. The popcorn (I tried fruity and got dichotomy) was soooo good. The buckeyes were just so so in my book. (My sister makes better ones!) Overall, definitely worth a stop. :)

text: Ótimo lugar para tomar um café da manhã rápido ou um lanche. Gosto muito que esteja localizado em frente aos elevadores do hotel, para que não precise caminhar muito para conseguir um bom pão de queijo. Adoro o pão de queijo com presunto e queijo e também apreciam um bom café.
text_en: A great place for a quick breakfast or a snack. I really like that it’s located right in front of the hotel elevators, so you don’t have to walk far to get some good cheese bread. I love cheese bread with ham and cheese, and I also enjoy a good coffee there.
original: Great Place to get a quick breakfast, or snack. I really like that it is right across from the hotel elevators so you don't have to walk too far to get a good pastry. I really enjoy their Ham & Cheese criossant and they make a nice cup of coffe.

text: Great bakery with fresh authentic Chinese bread. And there are so many choices. But too bad it's in the worst plaza ever where there's never enough parking. Driving there and finding parking is a nightmare. This entire plaza needs a better parking solution.
text_en: Great bakery with fresh authentic Chinese bread. And there are so many choices. But too bad it's in the worst plaza ever where there's never enough parking. Driving there and finding parking is a nightmare. This entire plaza needs a better parking solution.

text: Este es un lugar de donuts que siempre debo visitar cuando voy a mi ciudad natal, Cleveland. Sus donuts son siempre deliciosos y muy frescos. ¡Espero volver a visitarlos pronto!
text_en: It’s a donut place that I always have to visit when I go to my hometown, Cleveland. Their donuts are always delicious and very fresh. I hope to visit them again soon!
original: This is a donut place I always have to have when I visit my home town of Cleveland. They are always so good and so fresh. Se you guys again soon!

text: My mother and I walked into sprinkles on a whim while just exploring near our hotel. I sampled the cookie dough ice cream and the captain crunch ice cream. Honestly some of the best ice creams I've ever had . The cookie dough ice cream had big big chunks of cookie dough all throughout the deliciously vanilla flavored ice cream. The captain crunch one tasted just like the cereal and not too sweet with bits of the cereal mixed in. Super smooth and creamy. The waffle cone actually tasted of vanilla and not just processed sugar. My mom got the milk chocolate cupcake . She said she was impressed by how moist it was beautiful texture of the cake and frosting, not too sweet , just the right amount of frosting . She only wishes she got a big "ole" glass of milk with it . And everything wasn't overpriced either ! Next time we are visiting Vegas we will surely be back! Now Candace needs to build a sprinkles in MN !!!
