text_en: Excellent spot for cupcakes, cookies and ice cream. Reasonable prices and everything is very tasty. Good gluten free choices as well. I very much enjoyed this gem.

text: After hitting Grapes on Shea and Scottsdale for happy hour today- review coming shortly (maybe... hey, I've 12 other reviews that need to be written!), I headed to Sweet Republic for a sweet ending. I'd received a newsletter from SR that there were new flavors in honor of Valentine's Day, and I thought what a great reason to pay SR another visit! Of the two Valentine specials, Raspberry White Chocolate and White Roses, I could only sample the latter, as the former contained an allergen. I'm a sucker for floral-scented food and drink, and this SR delight was a winner! I could definitely taste roses, and the sweet cream wasn't too sweet. Loved it! I also sampled Desert Honey (a tart yogurt sweetened w/ local AZ wild desert honey), Almond Buttercrunch, Salted Butter Caramel, Cheese Course Duo, Espresso, and Mango Lassi. I took a pint of White Roses and Desert Honey ($7.50) and a scoop of Salted Butter Caramel to-go and a scoop of Almond Buttercrunch in a waffle cone (2 scoops $4.25 + $1 for waffle cone) to savor! I couldn't pass up a Chocolate Chip Walnut Oatmeal cookie ($3) as it looked so delicious on its cake display stand- one of the proprietors, Helen, offered to warm it up in the microwave. What a wonderful suggestion! I asked if she could tear off a section and warm it up... The warmed bite I took at the store was amazingly good! (I did notice that the rest of the soft-batch cookie, sampled in the car, was definitely saltier than I'd wish for in a cookie. Why didn't I detect this saltiness in the warmed-up section? Perhaps the sweetness of the almond buttercrunch made my tastebuds more sensitive to salt? Hmm...) I really enjoyed the almond buttercrunch and the cone, so much so that I wished I'd skipped on the salted butter caramel- heresy some fans of this flavor might think, but what can I say? I loved extra textural component, and the buttery toffee-sweet crunch, that the almonds provided. I may be back, maybe as soon as tomorrow!, to re-visit the espresso and the mango lassi (and grab a few more of those chocolate chip walnut cookies!). ;) p.s. Couldn't resist and just had to taste a couple scoopfuls of desert honey and white roses before placing the pint in the freezer... Oh. My. God! Run to SR before Valentine's Day is over and White Roses disappear from the rotation! (Just remember to bring your credit card- a visit could get expensive!)
text_en: After hitting Grapes on Shea and Scottsdale for happy hour today- review coming shortly (maybe... hey, I've 12 other reviews that need to be written!), I headed to Sweet Republic for a sweet ending. I'd received a newsletter from SR that there were new flavors in honor of Valentine's Day, and I thought what a great reason to pay SR another visit! Of the two Valentine specials, Raspberry White Chocolate and White Roses, I could only sample the latter, as the former contained an allergen. I'm a sucker for floral-scented food and drink, and this SR delight was a winner! I could definitely taste roses, and the sweet cream wasn't too sweet. Loved it! I also sampled Desert Honey (a tart yogurt sweetened w/ local AZ wild desert honey), Almond Buttercrunch, Salted Butter Caramel, Cheese Course Duo, Espresso, and Mango Lassi. I took a pint of White Roses and Desert Honey ($7.50) and a scoop of Salted Butter Caramel to-go and a scoop of Almond Buttercrunch in a waffle cone (2 scoops $4.25 + $1 for waffle cone) to savor! I couldn't pass up a Chocolate Chip Walnut Oatmeal cookie ($3) as it looked so delicious on its cake display stand- one of the proprietors, Helen, offered to warm it up in the microwave. What a wonderful suggestion! I asked if she could tear off a section and warm it up... The warmed bite I took at the store was amazingly good! (I did notice that the rest of the soft-batch cookie, sampled in the car, was definitely saltier than I'd wish for in a cookie. Why didn't I detect this saltiness in the warmed-up section? Perhaps the sweetness of the almond buttercrunch made my tastebuds more sensitive to salt? Hmm...) I really enjoyed the almond buttercrunch and the cone, so much so that I wished I'd skipped on the salted butter caramel- heresy some fans of this flavor might think, but what can I say? I loved extra textural component, and the buttery toffee-sweet crunch, that the almonds provided. I may be back, maybe as soon as tomorrow!, to re-visit the espresso and the mango lassi (and grab a few more of those chocolate chip walnut cookies!). ;) p.s. Couldn't resist and just had to taste a couple scoopfuls of desert honey and white roses before placing the pint in the freezer... Oh. My. God! Run to SR before Valentine's Day is over and White Roses disappear from the rotation! (Just remember to bring your credit card- a visit could get expensive!)

text: Pensei que, devido às altas avaliações, este seria um ótimo lugar para comer sorvete. Após analisar o extenso cardápio, decidi experimentar um "brownie hurricane". Não havia ninguém na fila, mas pareceu demorar um pouco para preparar. O que recebi foi um copo de sorvete derretido, com alguns biscoitos de chocolate. Estava muito desagradável, já tinha batidos de sorvete mais consistentes. Além disso, custou US$ 5 por esse sorvete derretido. Acho que nunca voltarei.
text_en: I thought that, due to the high ratings, this would be a great place to eat ice cream. After reviewing the extensive menu, I decided to try a “brownie hurricane”. There was no one in line, but it seemed to take a while to prepare. What I got was a cup of melted ice cream with some chocolate cookies. It was very unpleasant; I’ve already had more consistent ice creams before. Besides, it cost US$5 for just that melted ice cream. I think I’ll never go back.
original: I thought by all of the high star ratings that this place has, that this was going to be a great ice cream place. After reviewing the extensive menu, I decided to try a brownie hurricane. There was not anyone else waiting, and it seemed to take a while to prepare. What I received was a cup of melted ice cream with some brownies in it. It was very unappealing, I've had milkshakes thicker than this. On top of that it $5 for this melted ice cream, don't think I'll ever be going back.

text: The shape of ice cream was pretty and the Thai flavor was good. Selected blueberry as topping, and it was fresh and tastes great with the ice cream. However, I waited for 20 minutes to get this which was far longer than I expected.
text_en: The shape of ice cream was pretty and the Thai flavor was good. Selected blueberry as topping, and it was fresh and tastes great with the ice cream. However, I waited for 20 minutes to get this which was far longer than I expected.

text: La primera vez que fui allí, fue realmente increíble. Es un lugar muy agradable. Tenían una gran variedad de donuts para elegir. El donut que compré se llamaba "The Homer", como el personaje de "Los Simpson". Un donut clásico, con glaseado rosa y chispas. ¡Ese donut era literalmente más grande que mi cara! Era muy dulce y delicioso. ¡Definitivamente, cómprate un café o leche para acompañarlo! Donut Bar es muy popular. Por lo tanto, la principal desventaja es que no hay muchos asientos en el interior, aunque sí hay algunos afuera, a la sombra. ¡Es Las Vegas, incluso a la sombra la temperatura es de alrededor de 34°C! ¡Recomiendo totalmente que visites Donut Bar en el centro de Las Vegas!
text_en: The first time I went there, it was truly amazing. It’s a very pleasant place. They had a wide variety of donuts to choose from. The donut I bought was called “The Homer,” after the character from “The Simpsons”. It was a classic donut with pink frosting and sparkles. That donut was literally bigger than my face! It was very sweet and delicious. Definitely, get yourself some coffee or milk to pair with it! Donut Bar is very popular. So, the main drawback is that there aren’t many seats inside, although there are some outside, in the shade. After all, it’s Las Vegas—even in the shade, the temperature is around 34°C! I highly recommend visiting Donut Bar in the center of Las Vegas!
original: The first time ever going there it was pretty awesome. It's a pretty cool They had a lot of donuts to pick from. The donut I got was called "The Homer", yes like Homer Simpson. Classic donut, pink frosting, and sprinkles. That donut was literally bigger than my face, it was very sweet, and delicious. Totally grab a coffee or milk to go with it! Donut Bar is pretty popular. So the biggest downside is that there's not that many seats inside, they do have a few seat outside in the shade. It's Las Vegas, even in the shade it's like 102° outside. I would totally recommend someone to go to the Donut Bar in Downtown Las Vegas!

text: You owe it to yourself to get a treat from this stand. Super cool location under the bridge, bring cash and your sweet tooth as they have a lot of options!
text_en: You owe it to yourself to get a treat from this stand. Super cool location under the bridge, bring cash and your sweet tooth as they have a lot of options!

text: O serviço é péssimo. Eu trabalho na área e costumo parar por lá ocasionalmente. A comida é razoável para um lanche rápido, mas não é excepcional. Hoje, eu queria comer algo antes de uma reunião. Havia 5 pessoas à minha frente, e apenas uma pessoa estava atendendo os pedidos. As outras duas pessoas estavam olhando para um caixa perto da padaria. Outro funcionário estava reabastecendo bebidas e outros trabalhavam nos fundos, mas ninguém se ofereceu para ajudar a agilizar o atendimento. Mais cinco pessoas chegaram nos próximos dez minutos, e ainda assim, apenas uma pessoa estava atendendo os pedidos. Demorou mais de 30 minutos para finalmente ser atendido. Não vale a pena! Foi frustrante ver os funcionários simplesmente ignorando o fato de que havia uma fila enorme e apenas uma pessoa atendendo os clientes.
text_en: The service is terrible. I work in this area and often stop by there from time to time. The food is decent for a quick snack, but not exceptional. Today, I wanted to eat something before a meeting. There were 5 people in front of me, and only one person was handling orders. The other two people were looking at a cash register near the bakery. Another employee was refilling drinks, and others were working behind the scenes, but no one offered to help speed up the service. Five more people arrived in the next ten minutes, yet still only one person was serving customers. It took over 30 minutes before someone finally took care of my order. It’s not worth it! It was frustrating to see the staff simply ignoring the fact that there was a huge queue and only one person was serving customers.
original: The service is terrible. I work in the area and have stopped in every so often. The food is decent for a quick bite, not amazing. Tonight I wanted to grab a bite to eat before a meeting. There were 5 people ahead of me with one person actually taking orders. Two other workers were looking at a register down by the bakery. Another worker stocking beverages and people working in the back, but none stepped in to help orders go faster. Five more people came in over the next ten minutes and still just one person taking orders. It took over 30 minutes to finally get called. Not worth it! It was infuriating to see the workers just ignore the fact that there was a huge line and only one person getting customers food.

text: Friendly staff, lots of different options on the menu, and it's located in the Linq area. They are really busy but the tables and floors could use some cleaning. Delicious ice cream.
text_en: Friendly staff, lots of different options on the menu, and it's located in the Linq area. They are really busy but the tables and floors could use some cleaning. Delicious ice cream.

text: Paramos para comprar alguns sorvetes, pois estávamos céticos em relação às avaliações negativas dos sorveterias espalhadas pelas lojas ao redor do Grand Canal. Este lugar é um sonho para as crianças, pois é um lugar cheio de brinquedos coloridos, doces e sorvetes por todos os lados. E o sorvete era incrível! Pegamos um pote de baunilha e um de morango vegano, que, na verdade, estava muito bom. Sem dúvida, um sorvete de excelente qualidade.
text_en: We stopped to buy some ice cream, as we were skeptical about the negative reviews of ice cream shops around the Grand Canal. This place is a dream for children, with colorful toys, sweets, and ice cream everywhere. And the ice cream was incredible! We got a bottle of vanilla and one of vegan strawberry ice cream—both were really good. Undoubtedly, it was ice cream of excellent quality.
original: Stopped by for some ice cream because I was skeptical of the poor reviews of the gelato places scattered around the Grand Canal shoppes. This place is a kids dream come true because it's just so much fun colorful toys, and candy and ice cream everywhere. And the ice cream was amazing! We grabbed a scoop of vanilla and the vegan strawberry, which was actually really good. Solid ice cream for sure.

text: Always delicious. They have lots of great seasonal flavors (like espresso!) and the the cold fudge sundae is a classic.
text_en: Always delicious. They have lots of great seasonal flavors (like espresso!) and the the cold fudge sundae is a classic.

text: Panadería y cafetería parisina las 24 horas - ¡quién lo habría imaginado! Fácil acceso a Amélie, con un amplio aparcamiento y muchos asientos dentro de la cafetería. Simplemente pedí un croissant de chocolate doble y una tarta de chocolate. Los productos horneados no me convencieron demasiado. Hay un menú más amplio para sándwiches, ensaladas y bebidas, que no probé. El ambiente es encantador y muy bonito. Candelabros laterales y obras de arte con temática parisina, al estilo de "Alicia en el País de las Maravillas". ¡Un lugar divertido para pasar el día o la noche!
text_en: A 24-hour bakery and café in Paris – who would have thought! Easy access to Amélie, with plenty of parking space and many seats inside the café. I simply ordered a double chocolate croissant and a chocolate tart. The baked goods didn’t impress me much. There’s a wider menu for sandwiches, salads, and drinks, which I didn’t try. The atmosphere is lovely and beautiful. Side candelabras and art pieces with a Parisian theme, like those from “Alice in Wonderland”. A fun place to spend the day or night!
original: Parisian 24 hour bakery and cafe - who woulda thunk?! Easy access to Amelie's with a giant parking and plenty of seating inside the cafe. I simply got a double baked chocolate croissant and chocolate tart. The baked goods were just okay for me. There is a larger menu for sandwiches and salads and drinks which I didn't partake in. The atmosphere is whimsical and super cute. Sideway chandeliers, Paris themed art work decorated a la Alice in Wonderland. Fun place to spend some time in day or night!

text: Então, parei para comprar donuts para o trabalho... foi uma experiência incrível! Tantas opções! E só para dizer que todos os tipos de donuts eram deliciosos! Apenas olhar para todas as opções e decidir qual escolher foi muito difícil... comprei 12 donuts... os funcionários foram muito prestativos, explicando os diferentes tipos... e o lugar estava lotado! Acreditam que o "crime brûlée" é o produto mais vendido, então comprei um! Estava delicioso, mas bem doce. Também comprei um "maple bar" com bacon, que estava delicioso... como alguém poderia errar com essa combinação? Recomendo muito este lugar, mas vá antes que os donuts do dia acabem!
text_en: So, I stopped to buy donuts for work… it was an amazing experience! So many options! Just to say that all kinds of donuts were delicious! It was really hard to decide which one to choose from all the options… I bought 12 donuts. The staff were very helpful, explaining all the different types… and the place was crowded! I believe “Crème Brûlée” is the most popular item, so I got one! It was delicious, but quite sweet. I also got a “Maple Bar” with bacon; it was great… how could anyone go wrong with that combination? I highly recommend this place, but go early before the donuts run out!
original: So I stopped by to pick up donuts for work....it was very overwhelming! So many choices! And just let me say that every donut of any and every type was mouthwatering! Just looking at all the choices and making a decision was completely difficult....I got 12 donuts....the counter people were very helpful explaining the donuts...plus it was completely packed! The crime brÃ»lÃ©e's was allegedly their number one seller, so I got one of those! It was delicious but very sweet. I also got a maple bar with bacon very delicious...how could you go wrong with that combo anyway?! I highly recommend this place but get there before the days donuts are sold out!!

text: This place has some amazing pastries! The seating areas is decent and it's easy to find since it's on the main strip of Little Italy. The cannoli and lobster tails are really good and worth getting. The cookies are also authentic Italian cookies! The parking isn't great though. A lot of the street parking is very narrow there's a bunch of construction in the area. There was somewhat of a wait since it seemed they were understaffed and the employees seemed flustered. They have an old ticket system that you have to grab a number in the front.
text_en: This place has some amazing pastries! The seating areas is decent and it's easy to find since it's on the main strip of Little Italy. The cannoli and lobster tails are really good and worth getting. The cookies are also authentic Italian cookies! The parking isn't great though. A lot of the street parking is very narrow there's a bunch of construction in the area. There was somewhat of a wait since it seemed they were understaffed and the employees seemed flustered. They have an old ticket system that you have to grab a number in the front.

text: Me encantan muchísimo sus macarons y otros dulces pequeños, pero no me convencieron mucho los pequeños pasteles que compré para el cumpleaños de mi marido. Estaban secos y un poco insípidos, aunque no eran terribles, definitivamente no estaban al mismo nivel que sus otros productos.
text_en: I absolutely love their macarons and other small desserts, but the small cakes I bought for my husband’s birthday didn’t impress me very much. They were dry and a bit tasteless, though they weren’t terrible—definitely not on the same level as their other products.
original: I absolutely love their macaroons and other small sweets, but I wasn't very impressed with the small cakes I bought for my husband's birthday. They were dry and a little bland, while not terrible definitely not on the same level as their other options.

text: Visitei a 85C Bakery em San Diego em 2017, e um dos funcionários me informou que uma unidade LV estava em andamento. Dois anos depois, finalmente chegou! Esperei alguns dias após a inauguração para visitar, e era evidente que alguns aspectos precisavam de melhorias. Era 13h e a maioria das prateleiras estava vazia. Eles gritavam "PÃO FRESCO", mas estavam produzindo apenas 3 tipos diferentes: BerryTale, Choco Bun e tortas de ovo. No final, peguei algumas, simplesmente porque não havia muitas opções. A fila para o caixa demorou cerca de 30 minutos. Era segunda-feira e havia bebidas com sal marinho à promoção no aplicativo, mas quando fui pedir e perguntei ao caixa se era à promoção, ela disse que não faz promoções, pois é uma loja nova. Voltei uma segunda vez, desta vez, às 9h da manhã. As filas estavam melhores, a variedade era grande (não apenas caixas de BerryTale), e o "PÃO FRESCO" que estava saindo era de melhor qualidade. No final, comprei duas bandejas, pois não queria perder a oportunidade de experimentar tudo. Perguntei ao caixa se ainda não faziam promoções, pois queria aproveitar a oferta de "comprar um vale-presente de 20 dólares e ganhar uma caneca grátis", mas na última vez que visitei, disseram que não estavam fazendo. Ela me olhou com uma expressão confusa e disse que deveriam ter me informado sobre a promoção, e pediu desculpas pela informação incorreta. No final, jantei no Shanghai Plaza e observei a variedade, e vi que ainda tinham alguns itens premium (consegui ver alguém pegando um pão rosa, que devia ser o de chocolate com morango). Ainda havia uma fila do lado de fora, mas pelo menos pude ver que as prateleiras ainda estavam cheias de doces. Tenho grandes expectativas para a 85C e acho que ainda estão aperfeiçoando o serviço, pois todos estão vindo visitar e esperar nas filas. *Dica: há um quiosque na frente para pedir bebidas e bolos apenas! Uma garota atrás de mim não pegou uma bandeja e disse que só queria uma bebida. Uma das senhoras ao lado disse: "Você vai ter que esperar nessa fila por uma bebida?!" Avisei sobre o quiosque e ela foi e voltou rapidamente.
text_en: I visited 85C Bakery in San Diego in 2017. One of the employees told me that an LV unit was under construction. Two years later, it finally opened! I waited a few days after its opening before visiting, and it was clear that some aspects needed improvement. It was 1 PM, and most of the shelves were empty. They shouted “FRESH BREAD”, but they only produced three different products: BerryTale, Choco Bun, and egg cakes. In the end, I bought some items just because there weren’t many options. The line at the cash register took about 30 minutes. It was Monday, and there were drinks with sea salt in promotion on the app, but when I went to order, the cashier said they didn’t have any promotions, since it was a new store. I came back again, this time at 9 AM. The lines were better, the variety was greater (not just BerryTale boxes), and the “FRESH BREAD” they served was of better quality. In the end, I bought two trays, because I didn’t want to miss out on trying everything. I asked the cashier if they still had any promotions, as I wanted to take advantage of the offer of “buy a $20 gift card and get a free mug”. But last time I visited, they said they didn’t have any. She looked at me confusedly and said they should have informed me about the promotion, and apologized for the incorrect information. In the end, I had dinner at Shanghai Plaza and saw the variety of products. There were still some premium items (I saw someone taking a pink bread, which must be chocolate with strawberries). There was still a line outside, but at least I could see that the shelves were still full of sweets. I have high expectations for 85C, and I think they are still improving their service, as everyone comes to visit and waits in lines. *Tip: there’s a kiosk right in front for ordering drinks and cakes! A girl behind me didn’t get a tray and said she just wanted a drink. One of the women next to her said, “Do you really have to wait in that line for a drink?” I told her about the kiosk, and she went and came back quickly.
original: I went to the 85C Bakery in SD in 2017 and one of the workers told me that a LV location was in the works. Two years later, it's FINALLY HERE! I waited a couple days after the grand opening to visit and you could tell that some things needed improvement. It was 1pm and most of the shelves were empty. They would yell, "FRESH BREAD," but they were only cranking out 3 different kind - BerryTale, Choco Bun, and Egg Tarts. Ended up grabbing a few, just because there wasn't much to choose from. The line was about a 30 minute wait to get to the register. It was Monday and the had BOGO sea salt drinks advertised on their app, but when I go to order and ask the cashier if it's BOGO she says that they don't do promotions since they're a new store. I came a second time, this time, at 9am. The lines are better, the selection was plentiful (not just cases of BerryTale), and the FRESH BREAD that was coming out was more of the good stuff. Ended up with 2 trays full because I didn't want to pass up trying everything. I asked the cashier if they're still not doing promotions because I wanted to do the "buy a $20 gift card and get a free mug" deal, but the last time I visited they said they weren't doing it. She gave me a confused look and said they should've wrong me up for the promotion and apologized for the misinformation. I ended up eating dinner at Shanghai Plaza and took a peek at the selection and saw they still had some premium items (I could see someone picking up a pink bun which had to be the Strawberry Chocolate one). There was still a line outside, but at least I could see the shelves were still full of pastries. I have high hopes for 85C and think they're still working out the kinks because everyone and their mamas are coming to visit and wait out the lines. *Pro-tip: there's a kiosk in front to order drinks and cakes only! A girl behind me didn't grab a tray and said she only wanted a drink. One of the ladies next to me said, "you're going to wait in this line for a drink?!" I let her know about the kiosk and she was in and out quickly.

text: Mi heladería favorita de todos los tiempos. Está a solo 5 minutos en coche de mi casa y vengo aquí desde que era niño. Mi familia y yo venimos casi todas las semanas. Su helado es muy cremoso y no demasiado dulce. Casi siempre pido el de plátano, es único. El resto del tiempo, pruebo sus sabores de temporada, mis favoritos son el de plátano con mantequilla de cacahuete (¡sorpresa!), el de las tres bayas, el de tarta de limón y el de calabaza con caramelo y galletas de jengibre en otoño. Además, su helado de flor de naranja es perfecto para el verano, tiene un sabor similar al de un creamsicle y nunca lo he visto en otro lugar. A mi madre le encanta el sundae de frambuesa roja. Tienen sucursales por todo el área de Cleveland, pero he crecido viniendo a esta.
text_en: My favorite ice cream shop of all time. It’s just 5 minutes away by car from my house, and I’ve been going there since I was a child. My family and I go there almost every week. Their ice cream is very creamy, but not too sweet. I usually order the banana flavor—it’s unique. At other times, I try their seasonal flavors; my favorites are the banana with peanut butter (surprise!), the three-fruit flavor, lemon tart, and pumpkin with caramel and ginger cookies in autumn. Also, their orange flower ice cream is perfect for summer—it has a taste similar to a creamsicle, and I’ve never seen it anywhere else. My mother loves the red raspberry sundae. They have branches throughout the Cleveland area, but I grew up going here.
original: My favorite ice cream shop of all time. It's a quick 5 minute drive from my house and I've been coming here since I was a kid. My family and I come pretty much every week. Their ice cream is so creamy and not overly sugary. I get the banana ice cream 98% of the time, It's unlike any other. The other 2% of the time I get their seasonal flavors my favorite are banana peanut butter (shocker), triple berry, lemon meringue pie, and pumpkin caramel ginger snap in the fall! Also their orange blossom is perfect for the summertime it tastes like a light creamsicle and I've never seen this flavor anywhere else. My mom loves the red raspberry sundae. The have locations all over the Cleveland area but I've grown up coming to this one.

text: Quintinha charmosa. Seleção limitada de pratos e sorvete de qualidade mediana. É bom que o local esteja aberto até tarde.
text_en: Charming Quintinha. A limited selection of dishes and ice cream of medium quality. It’s good that the place is open until late.
original: Cute patio. Limited selection of menu and mediocre ice cream. Nice that this place is open late.

text: Visite Sweet Republic esta semana y diga: "Apoyo a 'Bake for Hope'", y ellos donarán una parte de sus ganancias a esta organización. "Bake for Hope" es una organización benéfica que busca concienciar sobre el cáncer de mama y destinar las ganancias de las ventas de pasteles a nivel nacional a las oficinas locales de Susan G. Komen for the Cure. Este sábado, "Bake for Hope" estará allí para vender nuestros deliciosos cupcakes, brownies y galletas caseras. ¡Es la combinación PERFECTA: pastel y helado!
text_en: Visit Sweet Republic this week and say, “I support ‘Bake for Hope.’” They will then donate a portion of their profits to this organization. “Bake for Hope” is a charitable organization that aims to raise awareness about breast cancer. The profits from selling cakes are directed to local offices of Susan G. Komen for the Cure. This Saturday, “Bake for Hope” will be there to sell our delicious cupcakes, brownies, and homemade cookies. It’s the perfect combination: cakes and ice cream!
original: Go to Sweet Republic this week and say, "I support Bake for Hope," and they will donate a portion of their proceeds to Bake for Hope. Bake for Hope is a charity that is raising breast cancer awareness and providing proceeds of nationwide bake sales to local Susan G Komen for the Cure affiliate offices. On this Saturday, Bake for Hope will be there to sell our delicious homemade cupcakes, brownies, and cookies. It is the PERFECT pairing- cake and ice cream!

text: Milk Bar no fue tan bueno como esperaba. Me perdí la ubicación en Nueva York y estaba deseando probarlo aquí en Las Vegas. Al no saber qué pedir, decidí probar el "Greatest Hits" (19 dólares), que incluía: una porción de tarta de nuez, helado de leche de cereal, bombones de cumpleaños (3) y una galleta de avena. También compré la galleta de maíz y la galleta de chocolate con chispas de maíz. Mi menos favorita fue el helado de leche de cereal con trozos. Realmente no tenía mucho sabor y era pequeña. La tarta de nuez también era pequeña. ¡Una estafa! La tarta de nuez estaba bien, pero no era espectacular. Los bombones de cumpleaños tenían una textura extraña, como si estuvieran demasiado blandos, poco cocidos o con demasiado harina. No fue muy agradable. De verdad quería probar el pastel de cumpleaños, pero no lo venden por porciones, solo entero (56 dólares). ¡Pero sí me gustaron las galletas! Probablemente las volvería a comprar, pero me gustaron más las galletas de maíz. Una gran desventaja es que no hay asientos ni mesas altas para disfrutar de los postres. Sin embargo, el servicio al cliente fue excelente. Si alguna vez estoy en la zona y quiero gastar dinero, podría volver por estas golosinas sobrevaloradas.
text_en: The Milk Bar wasn’t as good as I expected. I missed out on knowing where it was located in New York, and I really wanted to try it here in Las Vegas. Not knowing what to order, I decided to try the “Greatest Hits” (19 dollars), which included: a portion of walnut cake, cereal milk ice cream, birthday candies (3 pieces), and a oat cookie. I also bought the cornflake cookie and the chocolate cookie with cornflakes. My least favorite was the cereal milk ice cream with chunks. It really didn’t have much flavor, and it was small in size. The walnut cake was also small. It was a rip-off! The walnut cake was okay, but not impressive. The birthday candies had a strange texture—they seemed too soft, not well-cooked, or made with too much flour. It wasn’t very pleasant. I really wanted to try the birthday cake, but it isn’t sold in portions; it’s only available whole (56 dollars). But I did like the cookies! I might buy them again, but I preferred the cornflake cookies more. A major drawback is that there are no seats or high tables to enjoy the desserts. However, the customer service was excellent. If I’m in the area someday and want to spend money, I might come back for these overpriced treats.
original: Milk Bar wasn't as good as I thought it would be. I missed out on the NYC location and was looking forward to trying it here in Vegas. Not knowing what to try, I settled on the "Greatest Hits" ($19), which came with: slice of crack pie, cereal milk soft serve, bday truffles (3), and a compost cookie. I also purchased the corn cookie and the corn flake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie. My least favorite was the cereal milk soft serve with crunch. It didn't really taste like much and was small! The crack pie was also small. What a rip off. The crack pie was good, not amazing. Bday truffles had a strange mouth feel, like too doughy, undercooked, or flour-y. It wasn't that enjoyable. I really wanted to try the birthday cake, but they don't sell it by the slice, only whole ($56). I did like the cookies! I would try them all again, but I liked the corn cookie the best! One big flaw they have is no where to sit or even high top tables to enjoy your treats. Customer service was excellent though. If I am ever in the area and want to throw away some money, I might be back for these overpriced goodies.

text: ¡Me encanta LOVE page! Vengo aquí desde que era niño, y la calidad sigue siendo la misma: helados, batidos, etc., ¡e incluso las hamburguesas, perritos y papas fritas son aún mejores! Los precios son tan bajos que casi es increíble. Si estás en el sur de la ciudad y buscas helados de calidad, este es el lugar. Y créeme, vale la pena esperar en la fila, ¡siempre lo ha sido!
text_en: I love the LOVE page! I’ve been coming here since I was a child, and the quality remains the same: ice cream, smoothies, etc. Even hamburgers, hot dogs, and fries are even better! The prices are so low that it’s almost unbelievable. If you’re in the south part of the city and looking for high-quality ice cream, this is the place. And trust me, it’s worth waiting in line—it always has been!
original: LOVE page's, been coming here since i was a kid, same GREAT ice cream, shakes, etc, even BETTER burgers, dogs & fries, prices so low it's almost shocking, if you're in the south hills & want QUALITY soft serve this is the place, & believe me, it's worth the wait when the line is long, always has been

text: ¡Vaya! Hay muchos lugares que dicen ser los mejores, pero este es realmente excelente. Sloan's es delicioso. Pedimos la opción de degustación, que incluye 9 porciones de helado. Por cierto, las porciones son pequeñas... y me gustaría que no estuvieran todas en el mismo recipiente. Sería ideal tener un recipiente tipo caja de huevos. Sin embargo, el helado es delicioso. También pedí un brownie, porque me encantan los brownies. Soy muy exigente, y este fue uno de los mejores que he probado. En mi opinión, es un poco caro, pero al menos vale la pena.
text_en: Wow! There are many places that claim to be the best, but this is truly excellent. Sloan’s is delicious. We ordered the tasting option, which includes 9 servings of ice cream. By the way, the servings are small… and I wish they weren’t all in the same container. It would be ideal to have a container like an egg carton. However, the ice cream is really good. I also ordered a brownie, because I love brownies. I’m quite demanding, and this was one of the best ones I’ve tried. In my opinion, it’s a bit expensive, but at least it’s worth it.
original: Oh wow... A lot of places claim to be the best...but this is legit. Sloan's is so delicious! We got the luxury sampler which gets you 9 scoops of ice cream. FYI the scoops are small...and I wish they weren't all in the same container. It would be nice to have like an egg carton type container. However, the ice cream is delicious! I also got a brownie because brownies are my favorite. I am very picky and this was one of the best I've ever had. In my opinion it's expensive, but at least its worth it!

text: Vale... afuera hace mucho frío. Estoy usando un abrigo abrigado y la fila se extiende hasta el estacionamiento... Creo que esto lo dice todo. Simplemente lo mejor. Nada supera la experiencia de pasar un momento difícil en casa disfrutando de un delicioso helado de Handel. Muy recomendable.
text_en: Well… it’s very cold outside. I’m wearing a warm coat, and the line stretches all the way to the parking lot… I think that says it all. Simply the best. Nothing beats the feeling of spending a difficult moment at home while enjoying a delicious Handel ice cream. Highly recommended.
original: Ok.. it is getting very cold outside. I am wearing a heavy jacket and the queue extends into the parking lot... I think this says it all. Simply the best. Nothing gets you through a tough time of staying at home as a rewarding bucket of Handel's ice cream. More than recommended.

text: Eu comprei o bolo de aniversário e os pequenos bolinhos de aniversário, e ambos ficaram apenas "ok". Estavam bons, mas não eram excepcionais, considerando o preço de 14 dólares por fatia. Era o meu aniversário quando comprei, e recebi os bolinhos de presente, mas, para ser sincero, não me agradaram muito. Talvez na próxima, mas essa fatia no meu dia especial não foi tão boa.
text_en: I bought the birthday cake and the small birthday cookies, but both were just “okay”. They were good, but not exceptional, considering the price of $14 per piece. It was my birthday when I bought them, and I received the cookies as a gift, but to be honest, they didn’t really impress me. Maybe next time, but this piece of cake on my special day wasn’t very good.
original: I had the birthday cake and birthday cake balls and both were just meh. It was okay but not amazing for a $14 slice of cake. It was my birthday when I bought it and was kindly given the cake balls but i wasn't a fan honestly. Maybe next time but that slice on my big day didn't make the cut.

text: Este lugar es una cuestión de suerte. Mi favorito son las galletas de copos de maíz y la tarta de nueces. Todo lo demás, ya sea demasiado salado o demasiado dulce.
text_en: This place is a matter of luck. My favorites are cornflake cookies and nut cake. Everything else is either too salty or too sweet.
original: This place is a hit or miss. My favorite is the cornflake cookies and crack pie. Everything else is either too salty or overwhelmingly sweet.

text: A pior experiência em uma filial da Ghirardelli! Enquanto esperava pelo meu pedido, vimos baratas rastejando sob as mesas e nas paredes. Eu discretamente mencionei isso a um dos funcionários, pois já havia visto outras pessoas entrarem em pânico ao ver uma barata, e queria evitar que isso acontecesse com os outros. Ele contou para todos os colegas e eles começaram a rir. Depois, ele foi matá-la e me zombou, dizendo: "Nossa, tem baratas, como se elas fossem machucar alguém". Eu não consegui terminar o sorvete, estava muito incomodado com o atendimento.
text_en: The worst experience at a Ghirardelli branch! While waiting for my order, we saw cockroaches crawling under the tables and on the walls. I quietly mentioned this to one of the employees, because I had seen other people panic when they saw a cockroach, and I wanted to prevent that from happening to others. He told all his colleagues, and they started laughing. Then he went to kill the cockroach and mocked me, saying, “Wow, there are cockroaches here—as if they could hurt anyone.” I couldn’t finish my ice cream; I was very upset with the service.
original: Worst experience at a Ghirardelli ever! As I was waiting for my order we seen some roaches crawling under the tables and on the walls. I quietly mentioned it to one of the workers because I have seen other people explode in a store after seeing a roach and was trying to avoid that for them. He told every co worker there and they all started laughing. After he went to kill it he walked away and mocked me saying "OMG there's roaches, as if they're gonna hurt anybody" Did not even finish the ice cream I was disgusted by the service.

text: ¡El helado más delicioso que he probado! Es tan bueno que me encanta comerlo con un cono de waffle. Este lugar es increíble, ¡y tienes que probarlo!
text_en: The most delicious ice cream I’ve ever tried! It’s so good that I love eating it with a waffle cone. This place is amazing—you absolutely have to try it!
original: The best ice cream I've ever tried! So good, I love it with the waffle cone.. this place is just amazing and you have to try

text: Essas não são as melhores rosquinhas, mas também não são ruins. Já experimentei as rosquinhas deles em três ocasiões diferentes, e em todas, a experiência foi decepcionante. "Rosquinhas secas" é uma descrição que se encaixa bem.
text_en: These aren’t the best cookies, but they’re not bad either. I’ve tried their cookies on three different occasions, and in all cases, the experience was disappointing. “Dried cookies” is a good description for them.
original: These aren't awful donuts, but they certainly aren't the best. I've tried their donuts on three different occasions, and each time was a lackluster experience. Dry donuts describes it best.

text: O local é em uma área tranquila, mas o sorvete não era muito bom. Era aceitável, mas nada de especial. O sabor era fraco. O caramelo salgado tinha muito sal. Talvez tenha sido um lote defeituoso. Provavelmente não voltaria.
text_en: The place is in a quiet area, but the ice cream wasn’t very good. It was acceptable, but nothing special. The flavor was weak. The salty caramel had too much salt. Maybe it was a defective batch. Probably I wouldn’t go back.
original: The place is in a cool little area but the ice cream wasn't that great. It was okay but nothing special. It was tasteless. The salted caramel had way too much salt. This just could have been a bad batch. Probably wouldn't go back.

text: Não havia lugar para sentar e desfrutar do sundae de 23 dólares que compramos. Muito charmoso e divertido. Experimente se tiver a oportunidade. O atendimento é excelente, mas perdi duas estrelas por falta de lugares para sentar.
text_en: There was no place to sit and enjoy the $23 sundae we bought. It’s very charming and fun. Try it if you get the chance. The service is excellent, but I lost two stars because there were no seats to sit on.
original: No place to sit and enjoy the $23 sundae we bought. Super cute and fun. Get a scoop if you get a chance. Service is great, lost 2 stars due to no seating

text: ¡Increíble! Desde marcos de fotos hasta elementos decorativos de estilo francés que llegan hasta el techo, un ambiente impresionante... Y no olvidemos el ambiente. Definitivamente un lugar al que acudir cuando se tiene antojo de algo delicioso. Sin importar la hora o la ocasión. Los precios pueden ser un poco elevados, pero la experiencia en sí misma lo vale. Además, ¡los brownies con caramelo salado son los mejores! Me encanta Amelie's, ¡definitivamente volveré!
text_en: Incredible! From photo frames to French-style decorative elements that reach up to the ceiling—it’s a truly impressive atmosphere… And we must not forget the ambiance. Definitely a place to go when you have a craving for something delicious. No matter the time or occasion. The prices might be a bit high, but the experience itself is worth it. Moreover, the brownies with salty caramel are the best! I love Amelie’s—I’ll definitely return!
original: Wow! From picture frames, to ceiling high french props, amazing scenery... Not to mention the atmosphere. Definitely a must come to when craving some treats! No matter the time or occasion. The prices may be a tad high, but just the experience is worth it. Not to mention the best caramel salted brownie treats! Love Amelie's, def coming back!

text: Esta é a nossa primeira vez aqui. Se não fosse pela cor rosa vibrante e o clima agradável, provavelmente teríamos simplesmente passado. Eles oferecem uma variedade de bebidas, desde água até opções com frutas e CBD. Além disso, têm espressos e muitos sabores de sorvete. Também têm diversos itens, como balas de cigarro, que eu adorava quando criança. A equipe foi simpática e o sorvete estava excelente. Pena que eu não posso comer sorvete de verdade. Minha filha comeu o sorvete de verdade.
text_en: This is our first time here. If it weren’t for the bright pink color and pleasant atmosphere, we probably would have just passed by. They offer a variety of drinks, from water to those with fruits and CBD. Additionally, they have espresso machines and many ice cream flavors. They also have various items like cigarette candies, which I loved as a child. The staff was friendly, and the ice cream was excellent. It’s a pity that I can’t eat real ice cream. My daughter ate the real ice cream.
original: This is our first time here. If it wasn't for the hot pink and the weather being nice outside, we may have just kept walking. They have a handful of drinks from water to fruity to CBD drinks. Along with espressos, and lots of ice cream available. They have an assortment of different items like cigarette candy, loved that stuff as a kid. The staff was friendly and the ice cream was terrific. Too bad I can't have real ice cream. My daughter had the real ice cream.

text: Casi siempre tengo que parar aquí para comprar helado cuando estoy en Ohio City. La única vez que no lo hago es cuando estoy en una dieta, jaja. De todas formas, fui la semana pasada y siempre me impresiona su excelente servicio. Me permiten probar todos los sabores que quiera y no se quejen. Me encanta la estructura de cristal y cómo se puede subir a otra planta para ver cómo preparan su producto. ¡Es muy interesante! Normalmente no presto atención a las opciones de sorbete o helado vegano, ya que suelo optar por el helado cremoso. Pero mi amigo quería comprar helado vegano para llevar, y resulta que tenían dos opciones: uno de chocolate y otro de caramelo salado. Compró uno de cada sabor y ¡incluso vendían conos veganos!
text_en: Almost always, I have to stop here to buy ice cream when I’m in Ohio City. The only time I don’t do it is when I’m on a diet, haha. Anyway, I went there last week, and I’m always impressed by their excellent service. They allow me to try all the flavors I want without anyone complaining. I really like the glass structure of the products, and it’s interesting how they can go up to another floor to see how their products are prepared. Usually, I don’t pay attention to the options for sorbet or vegan ice cream, since I usually choose creamy ice cream. But my friend wanted to buy vegan ice cream to take home, and they had two options: one with chocolate and one with salty caramel. He bought one of each flavor, and they even sold vegan cones!
original: I almost always have to stop and get ice cream here when I'm in Ohio city! The only time I don't is when I'm on a diet lol! Anyways I visited this past week and I am always amazed at their attentive service. They allow you to try as many flavors as you want and don't get upset. I love the glass walls and how you can go upstairs and watch how they make their product! Very cool! Usually I don't pay attention to sorbets or vegan ice cream options because I usually go for the creamy ice cream - I have no restrictions when it comes to ice cream. But my friend wanted to stop in to get vegan ice cream togo and what do you know.. they had 2 vegan options chocolate and a salty caramel. He bought 1 of each pint and they even sold Vegan cones!

text: Advertencia: Esta reseña de cinco estrellas se basa en una nostalgia extrema. Cuando era pequeño, insistía en que íbamos aquí después de cada visita al zoológico. Ahora que ya puedo conducir, me sorprende que no vaya aquí con más frecuencia. Honey Hut es el helado más consistentemente delicioso de Cleveland. Para algunos, puede parecer una opinión controvertida, pero yo la defiendo. Nunca he ido aquí y no me haya complacido con el sabor, el precio y el ambiente acogedor de este pequeño puesto. Esta vez, probé el sabor especial: banana con chispas de chocolate. Era lo suficientemente "de banana" y tenía un sabor increíblemente fresco. Mi madre eligió el sabor clásico de miel y nueces. Este sabor siempre es un éxito en mi opinión. Aunque es muy dulce, las nueces equilibran el sabor y te hacen disfrutarlo con calma, en lugar de consumirlo en dos segundos. Mi hermana probó el helado de chocolate y mantequilla de cacahuete. Aunque no soy fan del helado de chocolate, ella se fue con una sonrisa en la cara.
text_en: Warning: This five-star review is based on extreme nostalgia. When I was young, I insisted that we go here after every zoo visit. Now that I can drive, it surprises me that I don’t go here more often. Honey Hut is the most consistently delicious ice cream in Cleveland. For some, this might seem like a controversial opinion, but I stand by it. I’ve never been here before, and I’ve never been satisfied with the taste, price, or cozy atmosphere of this small shop. This time, I tried the special flavor: banana with chocolate chips. It was quite “banana-like” and had an incredibly fresh taste. My mother chose the classic honey and nuts flavor. In my opinion, this flavor always succeeds. Although it’s very sweet, the nuts balance the taste, allowing you to enjoy it slowly, instead of eating it in two seconds. My sister tried the chocolate and peanut butter ice cream. Even though I’m not a fan of chocolate ice cream, she left with a smile on her face.
original: Warning: This five-star review is bolstered by extreme nostalgia. Little me asked, no, demanded that we went here after every zoo trip. Now that not-as-little me can drive, I'm shocked that I don't go here more. Honey Hut is the most consistently delicious ice cream in Cleveland. A hot take for some, but I stand by it. Not once have I gone here and not been pleased with the flavor I picked, the price, and welcoming atmosphere of this little stand. This time around, I got the featured flavor - banana chocolate chip. Just banana-y enough and tasted impressively fresh. My mom went for the classic honey pecan flavor. This flavor is always a winner in my book. While it is incredibly sweet, the nut pieces balance it out and make you take your time rather than consuming it in two seconds flat. My sister got chocolate peanut butter. While I'm not a chocolate-based ice cream fan, she still left with a smile on her face.

text: The gluten free birthday cake truffles are ridiculous. Stopped by to pick some up, and was able to grab a few 3 packs. Service was fast and friendly. The cake bites are honestly perfect. They're soft and cake-y without being crumbly or having that "gluten-free" taste. No mealy, pasty texture. They're perfect, and it was too easy to get them.
text_en: The gluten free birthday cake truffles are ridiculous. Stopped by to pick some up, and was able to grab a few 3 packs. Service was fast and friendly. The cake bites are honestly perfect. They're soft and cake-y without being crumbly or having that "gluten-free" taste. No mealy, pasty texture. They're perfect, and it was too easy to get them.

text: Amazing! Best deserts and pastries I've ever tried. Have to go back before I leave Vegas.
text_en: Amazing! Best deserts and pastries I've ever tried. Have to go back before I leave Vegas.

text: Great flavors but I'm docking a star for portion size. I've eaten at other locations and the portions are significantly larger. These were notably small and one of our orders was given to the wrong person and we got hassled about it. They ultimately remade it but we thought for a moment that they were going to try and charge us to remake it. If the flavors hadn't been so strong, I would have given one or two less stars for the overall experience.
text_en: Great flavors but I'm docking a star for portion size. I've eaten at other locations and the portions are significantly larger. These were notably small and one of our orders was given to the wrong person and we got hassled about it. They ultimately remade it but we thought for a moment that they were going to try and charge us to remake it. If the flavors hadn't been so strong, I would have given one or two less stars for the overall experience.

text: Si estás cerca del West Side Market, una parada en Campbell's Sweets es imprescindible. Quizás no sea imprescindible, pero si te gustan los dulces deliciosos, definitivamente vale la pena detenerse. Tienen palomitas de maíz en todos los sabores (el estilo es similar al de una mezcla de Chicago), chocolates y, quizás, mi favorito... cupcakes. Durante este confinamiento, ofrecen pedidos con anticipación que se pueden realizar durante toda la semana y recoger los viernes por la tarde. Exactamente lo que necesitas para pasar el fin de semana. No olvides consultar su cuenta de Instagram cada semana. La disponibilidad de los productos cambia semanalmente. Simplemente te acercas, llamas y ofrecen entrega sin contacto en tu coche.
text_en: If you’re near West Side Market, a stop at Campbell’s Sweets is essential. Maybe it isn’t absolutely necessary, but if you like delicious sweets, it’s definitely worth a visit. They have popcorn in all flavors (the style is similar to Chicago-style mix), chocolates, and, perhaps, my favorite… cupcakes. During this lockdown, they offer pre-order services that can be completed throughout the week, and picked up on Friday afternoon. It’s exactly what you need for the weekend. Don’t forget to check their Instagram account every week—the availability of products changes weekly. Just go there, call them, and they will deliver to your car without any contact.
original: If you're around the West Side Market, a stop to Campbell's Sweets is a necessity. Maybe not a necessity, but if you like delicious treats, it's definitely worth your time to stop in. They have popcorn in all types of flavors (dichotomy is similar to a Chicago mix style), chocolates, and perhaps my favorite... cupcakes. During this quarantine, they have call ahead orders that can be placed through the week and picked up on Friday afternoons. Exactly what you need to get you through the weekend. Be sure to check out their instagram account each week. The items available changes weekly. You simply pull up, call, and they have contact free delivery at your car.

text: This place is so cute!!! The ice creams are super flavorful and it's very hard to stop at one. I wished I could try them all! Not to mention the great decor around the place. Definitely ready for some great foodie pictures. We went when the place was close to closing time. Whereas most staff but get frustrated with late customers, the staff here was ready to help!
text_en: This place is so cute!!! The ice creams are super flavorful and it's very hard to stop at one. I wished I could try them all! Not to mention the great decor around the place. Definitely ready for some great foodie pictures. We went when the place was close to closing time. Whereas most staff but get frustrated with late customers, the staff here was ready to help!

text: Rule: if there is no line, go and grab ice cream! This was the original Jeni's location in Charlotte and still super popular. The staff are super friendly, masked-up and ready to go. The stand alone building only has counter seating and the line moves through pretty fast. Lots of outdoor tables to sit at or the large concrete steps behind the store. I really only went in here to get a few pints to take home, so I'm not sure how they are handling samples during Covid, but they always gave you separate sampling spoons and the the staff always wore gloves before the pandemic. Southend is pretty lucky to have a cool spot like Jeni's to enjoy after going to one of the many restaurants nearby.
text_en: Rule: if there is no line, go and grab ice cream! This was the original Jeni's location in Charlotte and still super popular. The staff are super friendly, masked-up and ready to go. The stand alone building only has counter seating and the line moves through pretty fast. Lots of outdoor tables to sit at or the large concrete steps behind the store. I really only went in here to get a few pints to take home, so I'm not sure how they are handling samples during Covid, but they always gave you separate sampling spoons and the the staff always wore gloves before the pandemic. Southend is pretty lucky to have a cool spot like Jeni's to enjoy after going to one of the many restaurants nearby.

text: Best ice cream in Vegas! A variety of flavors and different presentations. The kids that work there are great!
text_en: Best ice cream in Vegas! A variety of flavors and different presentations. The kids that work there are great!

text: Entramos después de ver los malvaviscos tostados que tenían en sus helados de s'mores. Cuando entramos, no había nadie, lo cual fue perfecto porque quería probar los diferentes sabores. La chica detrás del mostrador fue muy amable y nos permitió probar los sabores que queríamos. Estaba muy indecisa sobre qué sabores quería para mi helado, pero me dijo que podía preparar uno con hasta cuatro sabores. ¡Estaba muy emocionada! Pedí una combinación de vainilla tahitiana, chocolate doble, galleta con menta y mantequilla de maní en el helado de s'mores. Todos son increíbles. Muy cremosos y llenos de sabor. Sin duda, el mejor helado que he probado. Los malvaviscos tostados y las galletas Graham realmente realzaron el sabor del helado. Definitivamente volveré.
text_en: We entered after seeing the toasted marshmallows in their s’mores ice cream. When we arrived, there was no one there, which was perfect because I wanted to try all the different flavors. The girl behind the counter was very friendly and allowed us to try the flavors we wanted. She was unsure about which flavors I wanted for my ice cream, but she said I could make an ice cream with up to four flavors. She was really excited! I ordered a combination of Tahitian vanilla, double chocolate, mint biscuit, and peanut butter in the s’mores ice cream. All of them are amazing. Very creamy and full of flavor. Without a doubt, it’s the best ice cream I’ve ever tried. The toasted marshmallows and Graham biscuits really enhanced the flavor of the ice cream. I definitely will come back.
original: Went in after seeing the toasted marshmallow they had on their smores sundaes. There was no one there when we went in, which was perfect because I wanted to try the flavors. The girl behind the counter was super nice and let us try whatever flavors we wanted. I was very undecided on the flavors I wanted for my sundae but she said she could do up to four! I was so excited. I got a combination of Tahitian Vanilla, Double Chocolate, Minty Cookie, and Peanut Butter in the smores sundae. They are all phenomenal. So smooth and bursting with flavor. By far the best ice cream I have ever had. The toasted marshmallow and graham crackers really elevated the ice cream. Will definitely be back.

text: Nunca había oído hablar de este lugar, pero sí de la exposición. Está ubicado dentro del Hotel y Casino Venetian, en el segundo piso. Vine aquí solo porque mi esposa insistió. Cuando vi lo largo que era la cola, tuvo que pedir más insistentemente porque no podía imaginar esperar 45 minutos por un pequeño postre. Mientras estaba en la cola, podía oír a las mujeres hablando y presumiendo de cuánto habían gastado en la panadería de Carlos: ¡60, 75, 85 dólares! ¡Eso sí que debe ser delicioso! Algunas de estas mujeres habían estado aquí varias veces. Una vez que finalmente llegas al frente de la cola, solo permiten que entren a algunas personas a la vez. ¡TEN CUIDADO! Ten en cuenta lo que quieres, porque si no, te dejarán esperando o la persona que está detrás de ti te comerá vivo. Anotan tu pedido, y luego tienes que esperar (otros 10 minutos) en uno de los 5 asientos hasta que te llamen para pagar. ¿Qué pasó con esas panaderías donde simplemente te acercas, eliges lo que quieres y una mujer mexicana te lo pone en una bolsa? Este lugar te obliga a esperar mientras preparan tus dulces en una elegante caja blanca con una cinta, ¡y te cobran una fortuna! "Así que todo el dinero de los consumidores va a la envoltura". Pedí dos cannolis pequeños, uno normal y otro de chocolate. Los cannolis grandes cuestan $4, mientras que los pequeños cuestan $2.50. Estaban bien, pero para mí no eran excepcionales. Tal vez es todo la anticipación que no cumplió mis expectativas. Si la cola fuera mucho más corta y los postres fueran un poco más baratos, esta calificación probablemente habría sido de 4 estrellas.
text_en: I had never heard of this place before, but I’ve heard about the exhibition. It’s located inside the Venetian Hotel and Casino, on the second floor. I came here just because my wife insisted. When I saw how long the line was, she had to insist even more, because she couldn’t imagine waiting 45 minutes for a small dessert. While in line, I could hear the women talking and bragging about how much they spent at Carlos’ bakery: 60, 75, 85 dollars! That must be delicious! Some of these women had been here several times. Once you finally get to the front of the line, only a few people are allowed in at a time. BE CAREFUL! Think about what you want, because otherwise, they might leave you waiting or someone behind you might eat you alive. They write down your order, and then you have to wait (another 10 minutes) in one of the 5 seats until they call you to pay. What happened to those bakeries where you just go over, choose what you want, and a Mexican woman puts it in a bag for you? This place forces you to wait while they prepare your desserts in an elegant white box with a ribbon, and they charge a lot of money! “So all the customers’ money goes to the wrapping.” I ordered two small cannoli, one regular and one chocolate. The large cannoli cost $4, while the small ones cost $2.50. They were good, but not exceptional for me. Maybe it’s just the anticipation that didn’t meet my expectations. If the line were shorter and the desserts were a little cheaper, this rating would probably be 4 stars.
original: I've never heard of this place but I've heard of the show. It's located inside the Venetian Hotel & Casino on the 2nd floor. I only came here because my wife begged to come. When I saw how long the line was, she had to do some more begging because I couldn't fathom waiting 45 minutes for a small dessert. While standing in line I can over hear ladies conversations bragging about how much they've spent at Carlos bakery, $60, $75, $85 WOW! These things better taste pretty damn good. Some of these ladies had been here multiple times! Once you finally get to the front of the line they will only let a few people go in at a time. Be ALERT know what you want, because you will get skipped or the person behind you is going to eat you alive. They write down your order, then at that point you wait (another 10 min) in one of 5 chairs for your name to be called so that you can pay. WTF? Whatever happened to those bakery or panaderias where you walk up, pick what you want and some Mexican lady, with tongs, puts it in a bag and you go! This place makes you wait while they put your sweets in a fancy white box, with a ribbon tie and charge you up the wazoo! "So that's where all the consumer money goes, into the packaging." I ordered 2 small cannoli's, regular and chocolate. The large cannoli's are $4 while the mini cannoli's are $2.50. They were good, but to ME not out of this world good. Maybe it's all the anticipation built up that didn't live up to my expectations. If the line would have been way shorter and the sweets a little less expensive this rating probably would have been a 4 star.

text: Estoy muy contento de haberle dado una segunda oportunidad a Sprinkles. Evitar su ubicación original en Beverly Hills durante los últimos años, debido a que no me había impresionado, pero siempre quise probar su helado. La nueva ubicación en The Linq, en el Strip de Las Vegas, que me recuerda un poco a Los Ángeles, tenía tanto una sección de cupcakes como una de helados. Un momento perfecto a media tarde (aunque en Las Vegas siempre hace calor y se puede comer helado en cualquier momento del día). Pocos clientes en la sección de cupcakes, nadie en la de helados. ¡UN montón de sabores, la mayoría cambian diariamente! Tantas opciones interesantes, mi instinto me decía que quería probarlos todos. Opté por una muestra del único sabor de sorbete, fresa, ¡y me encantó! ¡Demasiado bueno, muy refrescante, simplemente perfecto! Vine por un cono de waffle de vainilla roja, pero terminé queriendo un sundae de cupcake. Elegí un cupcake, lo cortaron y lo llenaron de helado. Opté por el de vainilla roja y ¡me encantó! Muy fresco, suave, húmedo, todo lo que un cupcake debería ser. El glaseado de queso crema tenía demasiado azúcar, no es mi favorito, pero ahora estoy convencido de que no es solo publicidad, ¡Sprinkles hace unos cupcakes realmente buenos, y volveré a probar su helado!
text_en: I’m very happy that I gave Sprinkles a second chance. Over the past few years, I avoided their original location in Beverly Hills because it didn’t impress me, but I always wanted to try their ice cream. The new location at The Linq on the Las Vegas Strip reminds me a bit of Los Angeles—it has both a cupcake section and an ice cream section. It’s the perfect time to go there in the afternoon (though it’s always hot in Las Vegas, so you can eat ice cream anytime of the day). There are few customers in the cupcake section, and none in the ice cream section. So many flavors—most change daily! So many interesting options; my instinct told me I wanted to try them all. I chose a sample of the only sorbet flavor available—strawberry—and I loved it! It was too good, very refreshing, simply perfect! I came for a red vanilla waffle cone, but I ended up wanting a cupcake sundae instead. I picked a cupcake, it was cut up, and filled with ice cream. I chose the red vanilla one, and I loved it! Very fresh, soft, moist—just what a cupcake should be. The cream cheese frosting had too much sugar; it’s not my favorite, but now I’m convinced it’s not just advertising. Sprinkles makes really good cupcakes, and I’ll definitely try their ice cream again!
original: I am SO glad I gave Sprinkles another chance. Not being wowed by their original Beverly Hills location avoided them for the last few years but kept wanting to try their ice cream. A new addition to the Vegas Strip, The Linq, which reminds me a bit of LA anyways, had a Sprinkles location both for cupcakes AND ice cream! Perfect timing in the middle of the afternoon (though Vegas is always hot and you can eat ice cream any time of day) A few customers in the cupcake side, no one at the ice cream counter. TONS of flavors, most rotate daily, we had about 20 to chose from. So many great sounding flavors, the usual pig in my would have wanted to sample them all. I went with a sample of the only sorbet, strawberry, and was SOLD! THAT good, SO refreshing, simply perfect. I came for the red velvet waffle cone but wound up "needing" a cupcake sundae. Chose a cupcake, they split and fill with ice cream. Went with the red velvet and was in love! So fresh, soft, moist, everything a cupcake should be. The cream cheese frosting had way too much sugar, not my fav, but I am now finally convinced that it is not just hype, Sprinkles really makes some great cupcakes and I will be back for more of that ice cream!

text: O Sprinkles nunca decepciona! Vimos-o de longe, graças à sua placa com o símbolo duplo e estilo "Vegas". Se você viaja com frequência, sabe do que estou falando. De qualquer forma, há uma fila separada para os cupcakes e para o sorvete – o que foi ótimo, pois queríamos o sorvete e conseguimos o nosso imediatamente, enquanto havia uma longa fila de cupcakes do outro lado. Eles também oferecem os cupcakes do tamanho normal e mini-sundaes, que adoramos! Além disso, as porções são ótimas. O atendimento foi amigável e rápido. O sorvete e o mini-cupcake estavam ótimos, como sempre. Há alguns lugares para sentar do lado de fora – e se estiver muito cheio, há uma fonte próxima onde também podemos sentar, o que acabamos fazendo. Recomendo muito!
text_en: Sprinkles never disappoints! We saw it from a distance, thanks to its double symbol and “Vegas” style logo. If you travel often, you know what I’m talking about. Anyway, there’s a separate line for cupcakes and ice cream – which was great, because we wanted the ice cream right away, and we got it immediately, while there was a long line for cupcakes on the other side. They also offer regular-sized cupcakes and mini-sundae, which we love! Additionally, the portions are excellent. The service was friendly and quick. The ice cream and mini-cupcakes were great, as always. There are some seats to sit in outside – and if it’s very crowded, there’s a fountain nearby where we can sit too, which we did. I highly recommend it!
original: Sprinkles never disappoints! We spotted it from a distance due to their double dot, Vegas-style jazzed up sign! If you're a frequent flyer, you know what I'm talking about. Anyway there is a separate line for the cupcakes and for the ice cream -- which was great because we wanted the latter and got our ice cream right away while there was a long cupcake line on the other side. They do both Sprinkles regular sized as well as mini-sundaes which we love! They're great portion control as well. Service was friendly, and fast! Ice cream and mini cupcake were great, as usual. There's some seating right outside -- and if that's too crowded, there's a fountain close by to sit along which is what we ended up doing. Definitely recommend!

text: He ido a la sucursal de Davidson más de 10 veces, y sí, debo gustarme si sigo volviendo, pero tengo que decir que en las últimas ocasiones, el área de comedor estaba muy sucia. Entiendo que la combinación de clientes y el tiempo de espera pueden dificultar la limpieza de las mesas, pero la última vez, simplemente parecía sucio. El sopa de espárragos, cebolla o espinacas siempre es excelente. Los brownies de caramelo salado son magníficos. Si hicieran una limpieza profunda y emplearan a algunas personas adicionales para limpiar las mesas, sería de gran ayuda. Pedí un pastel de graduación, que fue maravilloso y valió la pena los $70.00.
text_en: I’ve been to the Davidson branch more than 10 times. Yes, I must like it if I keep coming back, but I have to say that in recent visits, the dining area was very dirty. I understand that the combination of customers and waiting time can make it difficult to clean the tables properly, but last time, it just looked really messy. The asparagus, onion, or spinach soup is always excellent. The salty caramel brownies are fantastic too. If they could do a thorough cleaning and hire some extra people to clean the tables, it would be very helpful. I ordered a graduation cake, which was wonderful—it was worth the $70.00.
original: I have been to the Davidson location over 10 times and yes, I must like it if I keep going back but I have to say that the last couple of times the eating area was very dirty. I realize the crowd combination turnaround time may lend itself to tables not being cleaned off, but last time it felt just plain grimy. The Asparagus Leek or Spinach leek soup is always excellent. The salted caramel brownies are superb. If they would do a deep cleaning and employ a few extra people to wipe down tables it would really be a big help! I have ordered a graduation cake which was wonderful and worth the $70.00 price tag.

text: ¡Me encanta este lugar! Cuando estamos en la zona, intentamos pasar por la tienda. En una ocasión, el helado de mi hijo se cayó del cono justo cuando lo estaba probando, y fue una de esas situaciones de los cómics en las que el niño tiene un cono vacío en la mano y el helado individual está en el suelo. Aunque ofrecí limpiar el helado del suelo y comprar otro, los empleados fueron amables y nos dieron un helado gratis, además de decirme que lo limpiarían. Excelente servicio al cliente y sabores únicos que no se pueden encontrar en ningún otro lugar.
text_en: I love this place! When we’re in the area, we try to pass by the store. Once, my son’s ice cream fell off the cone right as he was trying it—it was like that scene from a comic book where the child has an empty cone in hand and the individual ice cream pieces are on the ground. Although I offered to clean up the ice cream from the ground and buy another one, the staff were kind and gave us a free ice cream along with saying they would clean it up for us. Excellent customer service, and unique flavors that can’t be found anywhere else.
original: Love this place!! When we're in the area we try to stop by the store. On one occasion my son's ice cream fell off his cone as soon as he licked it and it was one of those scenes from a comic strips where the child has an empty cone in hand and the single scoop is on the floor. Even though I offered to clean up the ice cream on the floor and pay for another scoop of ice cream, the employees were nice enough to give us a free scoop and told me they would clean it up. Great customer service and unique flavors that you can't find anywhere else!
